tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rdo rje phur bu dngos grub char 'bebs kyi 'cham gyi brjed byang snang ba 'gyur thub bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn ma badz+ra kī la ya/ bla ma'i mchog gyur rje btsun sa lo dang / /yi dam mchog gyur rdo rje gzhon nu dpal/ /chos srung mchog gyur dkar bdud lcam dral la/ /sgo gsum mchog gi dwang bas phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan phur pa mchod pa'i cho ga gang / /rgyas pa'i yan lag sa chog phyag len gyi/ /bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'cham rim pa ni/ /snang ba 'gyur thub sa lo'i gsung bzhin bri/ /de la 'dir rdo rje phur bu dngos grub char 'bebs kyi phyag rgya'i gar 'cham ston pa la don gsum ste/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po sngon 'gro la don tshan bco lnga/ de'i dang po bar chad kyis mi tshugs par bya ba'i phyir chas gos gyon zhing phyag mtshan bzung ba ni blos bzung ba yan gyi cho ga phyag len bzhin song nas/ rnal 'byor pa ting nge 'dzin las su rung zhing bsnyen sgrub tshad du 'khyol ba'i gang zag yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pa rnams phod kha/ rdo rje gong pa/ rus pa'i mgul rgyan/ se ral kha/ dgos pa rnams la skra tshab/ zhwa thebs zhwa dar dang bcas pa/ 'byor na me long / gzungs mo chu thur/ rma bya'i sgro mdongs sogs kyis brgyan/ bla ma'i pur sol lam/ ma 'byor na ro sol mar dang bsres pa'i sna zhur 'then pa sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzhin bkod pa mdzes pa bshad tshod dang mthun pa chos dang ma 'gal ba'i chas gos lus la gyon zhing ban phur lag tu thogs/ gzhan snang shas mu cor gyi chas snang ba la gang dran byas pa dang / snang shas nyon mongs kyis khog pa khengs kyang sgyid snyom le lo dang / phangs sems dbang gis snang shas med mdog gis rgyan la chas bor byas na/ bla ma chos srung gi bka' chad 'phral du yong nges yin pas/ snang shas dang lha mchod pa'i bsam pa ma nor ba rang gal che bas gzab 'tshal/

stangs stabs kyis bzung ba la/ gsol ba gdab pa/ bgegs bskrad pa'i byin gyis brlab pa/ bka' bsgo ba rnams kho bos byas pa'i dkyil chog yid 'ong blo gros kha 'byed bzhin byas la/ stangs stabs dngos la rol mo dang bcas pas gnas de'am 'cham rwa gzhan du'ang rung ste/ don snod bcud thams cad rten dang brten pa'i rang bzhin du bsams nas byed pa yin pas so/ /gnyis pa lha srin sde brgyad zer mi ldang bar bya ba'i phyir gser skyems gtor zhing phur kha bsgyur ba ni/ rol mo gcams la/ 'cham mkhas shing lhun chags pa phod kha dkar po gyon pa gcig gis sna drangs la/ rol mo che ba re dang chung ba re spel ba'i 'theng rdung dang bstun che ba re la rkang g.yas btegs/ lag g.yas phur pa ban+dha la pad skor tshul du skor nas dpung g.yon steng du phur dar bkal/ rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs chung ba re la phab/ kha phyir blta/ yang che ba gcig la lag gnyis dpung steng gnyis su phyar zhing gsig chung ba la rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs phab/ kha nang la blta ste pad 'gros zhes so/ /tshul des steng ngam gang rigs su sleb pa dang / mchod g.yog pas phud chang bzung / dpon slob rnams kyis bdud rtsi byin rlabs sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi bar brjod/ de nas rol mo 'cham dang bcas pas/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / /sogs gser skyems rgyas pa dang / byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /sogs sgrub thabs bklags pa don grub nas 'byung ba ltar de'i kha skong du/ 'khon ston klu dbang srung ba yis/ /lha sa yer pa'i brag phug tu/ /ji ltar༞ ༞ gcung ston rdo rje rin chen gyis/ /drag po'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i tshe/ /ji ltar༞ ༞ 'khon ston bal po zhes bya yis/ /tsha mo rong gi brag phug tu/ /ji ltar༞ ༞ sngags 'chang rgya gar sher bzang gis/ /grum tsha mthon po bya ba ru/ /ji ltar༞ ༞ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis/

/'bab rong brag gi gnas mchog tu/ /ji ltar༞ ༞ rig 'dzin rnams kyi dus la bab/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la bab/ /byin gyis brlab pa'i dus la bab/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dus la bab/ /zhes pa'i rig 'dzin bskul/ do nub kyi phur kha gnyan po 'di/ /sogs nas/ rmi lam ngan sdigs byed la ston/ /gyi bar brjod cing rol mo bzlog pa bzhin drag brdung dang / mjug tu rol mo chem brdung dang kī la ya brjod/ thams cad kyis phur bu phyir bsgril lo/ /de nas rol mo gsum brdeg lan can grub mtshams sngar bzhin pad 'gros kyis 'cham gang mdzad sar phebs pa dang skor ba gcig song nas/ slob dpon khri'u chung la khyel mdzad de/ sa los mdzad pa'i 'cham bshad/ bla ma rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams dang / /zhes pa nas/ ha cang dal ba dang brel ba'i skyon spangs te phyag rgya'i rnam 'gyur bde zhing 'grigs pa gal che ba lags so/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ gzhan rnams kyis ma g.yengs pa'i ngang nas nyan par bya'o/ /'cham bshad rdzogs pa dang rol mo 'chams la 'og nas 'byung ba ltar yangs pa'i pad skor ji ltar rigs pa tshar ba dang / rol 'gros skor gcig bya/ de nas don tshan gsum pa nas brtsams te sa bcad rnams 'cham skad brda sprod kyi tshul du 'cham dpon gyis brjod do// ༈ /de la gsum pa sa gzhi 'khod snyoms par bya ba'i phyir 'cham skor lan gsum gyis gtan la dbab par bya zhes brjod/ de nas pad skor rnams kyi bar la rol mo chung ngu'i ngang nas gzhi pad bya ste/ chung gsum la pad skor rdzogs par bya/ gzhi pad ni lus kyi dbus/ g.yas phyogs/ yang dbus/ g.yon phyogs/ slar dbus dang lngar byed pa'o/ /gnas de rnams su pad skor byas pa'i rting ma rdzogs pa dang / lus kyi sgyid pa cung zad nem la rkang g.yas btegs/ lag pa gnyis mtho bar rol pa'i tshul du byed/ rol mo che ba bzhi'i gsum la rkang g.yas/ mdun/ g.yas/ rgyab rnams su rkang g.yas bzhag cing /

sgyid ldem che ba dang / rkang g.yon gyi rting pa/ rkang g.yas kyi rgyab tu btegs tsam re bya zhing g.yas phyogs su bskor/ che ba gcig la rkang g.yon bgrad nas g.yon ngos bzhag la kha rgyab phyogs su blta/ yang chung gsum la pad skor gcig byas/ che bzhi la rkang g.yon btegs/ rgyab/ g.yon/ mdun rnams rkang g.yon bzhag la sngar shul du log rkang g.yas bgrad la g.yas ngos bzhag pa/ rol mo'i grangs/ lus kyi rnam 'gyur sogs gong dang 'dra/ kha mdun du blta/ yang pad skor gcig byas lus gong bzhin nem nas rol 'gros skor gcig byed pa sogs 'cham skor dang po'o/ /rol mo de ga'i ngang nas kha nang du bltas la chung gsum la pad skor gcig bya/ lus nem la rkang g.yon btegs/ che gsum la mdun/ g.yon/ rgyab rnams su rkang g.yon bzhag g.yon phyogs su bskor/ che ba gcig la rkang g.yas bgrad nas g.yas ngos bzhag la/ kha rgyab phyogs su blta/ yang pad skor gcig byas/ che bzhi la rkang g.yas btegs/ rgyab/ g.yas/ mdun rnams su rkang g.yas bzhag la/ sngar shul du log rkang g.yon bgrad pa/ kha mdun du blta ba/ pad skor/ rol 'gros sogs gong dang 'dra ba ste 'cham skor gnyis pa'o/ /'cham skor gsum pa ni 'cham skor dang po bskyar nas bya ba yin no/ /'cham gyi dus kyi pad skor rnams yangs pa'i pad skor yin pas/ de yang rol mo chung ba gcig la phur pa ban+dha la bskor/ chung ba gcig la phur pa nam mkha' la phyar/ chung ba gcig la phur rtse ban nang du 'jug pa ste/ chung gsum la pad skor byed lugs so// ༈ /bzhi pa chos dbyings bskyed pa ni/ chos kyi dbyings bskyed par bya ba'i phyir skor ba lan gsum bya zhes brjod/ de la rol mo che ba gsum la rol pa bya ba ni/ lag gnyis brkyangs la rol mo re dang bstun lus g.yas g.yon du gcu ba'o/ /rol pa dang rol 'gros rnams kyi lag stabs thams cad 'dra ste/ mtho dman med par brgyangs la rgod nam mkhar lding ba lta bu'i lag gnyis kyi rtse mo gshog pa'i rtse mo ltar zlum po'i rnam pa legs shing mdzes pa kho na ma gtogs/

lag pa zha ba lta bu byung na mi yong bas lag gnyis mtho ba zhes gcig tu bya'o/ /rol pa tshar ba dang / gong bzhin gzhi pad byas la lag pa gnyis brgyangs/ rkang g.yas g.yas zur du bgrad la chung gsum la lag gnyis dang / rkang g.yas bsdu ba'i tshul du byas nas/ lag gnyis thugs kar mnyam/ rkang g.yas rkang g.yon thad du sleb pa dang / rol mo che ba gcig la ban phur nam mkha' la bsigs shing / rkang g.yas btegs la 'gying / de nas rol mo che ba bzhi la lag pa rol pa'i tshul dang / rkang pa g.yas/ mdun/ g.yas zur/ rgyab/ g.yon zur rnams su bzhag che ba gcig la rkang g.yon g.yon thad du bgrad la kha mdun du blta ba ste che lnga la g.yas skor bya/ yang chung gsum la pad skor gcig byas/ lag gnyis brgyangs/ rkang g.yon g.yon zur du bgrad/ chung gsum la lag gnyis dang rkang g.yon bsdu tshul byas/ lag gnyis thugs kar mnyam/ rkang g.yon rkang g.yas thad du sleb pa dang / lag gnyis nam mkha' la gzings/ rkang g.yon btegs nas rol mo che ba gcig la 'gying / de nas rol mo che ba bzhi la lag pa rol pa'i tshul dang / rkang pa g.yon/ mdun/ g.yon zur/ rgyab/ g.yas zur rnams su bzhag che ba gcig la rkang g.yas g.yas zur du bgrad la kha mdun du blta ba ste che lnga la g.yon bskor bya/ yang chung gsum la pad skor byed pa nas kha mdun du blta ba'i bar gong gi g.yas skor bzhin bskyar nas byas pa ste skor ba gsum mo/ /de nas 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes bya ste/ de'i tshul ni yangs pa'i pad skor la lus kyi dbus/ g.yon/ yang dbus/ g.yas rnams su byed pa ste pad skor bzhi/ 'phyong pad/ gzhi pad la pad skor lnga ste grangs 'di ni 'og tu gzhi pad/ 'phyong pad byung tshad la 'gre'o/ /de nas g.yas phyogs kyi brla steng du ban phur brkyangs te/ rkang g.yon gyi rting pa sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo 'gro phyogs la btegs nas 'gying dang bcas pas chung gsum la lag mgo gnyis cung zad bskyod pa'i dzam byas/

chung gsum ka la lus nem pa gcig byas la/ rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon zur du 'phyong ba'i gsig shin tu che ba dang bcas pas 'phyong zhing / lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol/ rkang pa g.yas pa'i sgyid khung du g.yon pa'i pus mo bcug la sgyid pa ldem dang bcas pas rnga skad gcig tsam gyi ring la rol mo'i sgra bcag nas 'gying ba ni 'phyong rjes so/ /'og tu 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes zhes pa thams cad 'dis rigs 'gre'o/ /de nas rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ lag gnyis rol pa ltar brgyangs/ rkang pa g.yon btegs pa de ga'i ngang nas rnga skad che ba gcig la lus g.yon pa nang la gcus te/ lag g.yon mtho bar ban+dha bzung ba'i mkhrig ma nang la gug pa dang / lag g.yas rkang g.yas phyogs su thur la brkyangs/ phur pa dang bcas mkhrig ma phyi la bkyed pa ste de bzhin du yang g.yas mtho ba dang / g.yon thur la brkyangs pa re mos kyis tshul bya zhing 'gros byed pa la skyod 'gros zhes bya'o/ /'og tu skyod 'gros dgos pa rnams 'dis rigs 'gre'o// ༈ /lnga pa snang srid dbang du bsdu ba ni/ snang srid dbang du bsdu bar bya ba'i phyir g.yab mo lan gsum bya zhes brjod/ rnga skad che ba gsum la rol pa/ de nas 'phyong pad bya ste dbus kyi pad skor rting ma'i dus su ban phur go brjes/ de nas g.yas kyi pad skor tshar ba dang / lus kyi rnam 'gyur sogs gong du bstan pa'i 'phyong rjes ltar dang / chung gsum la g.yas phyogs su dzam byas la che ba gcig la lag g.yon phur pa dku la brten/ g.yas ban+dha dang bcas pa g.yab pa'i tshul byed pa dang / rkang g.yas g.yon pa'i mdun du bzhag g.yas pa'i sgyid khung du g.yon pa'i pus mo btsugs/ ban+dha g.yas kyi pus mo'i steng du kha phub tu bzung / kha nang du blta ba'i tshul gyis lus gcus te 'dzum zhing ldem pa dang bcas pas rnga skad gnyis tsam gyi yun sgra bcag nas mgo dang ro stod 'gyed/

sked pa bsrangs nas 'gying / de nas chung ba gcig la lus 'phar zhing bsrang / lag g.yas dku la brten/ yang che ba gcig la g.yon phur pas g.yab pa dang rkang g.yon g.yas pa'i mdun du bzhag phur pa g.yon pa'i pus steng lag g.yon kha phub tu bzung ba ma gtogs lus po'i rnam 'gyur gong bzhin byed/ de bzhin du lus bsrangs te yang g.yas g.yab pa gong bzhin bskyar nas byed pa ste g.yab mo lan gsum mo/ /'di'i dus su sgyid pa rengs pa dang / sked pa chag cing mgo gug pa/ ro stod sgur ba sogs 'cham gyi skyon che ba lags pas ma byung ba gal che'o/ /de nas 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros skor gcig bya'o// ༈ /drug pa mkha' 'gro'i dpa' bskyed pa ni/ mkha' 'gro'i dpa' bskyed par bya ba'i phyir sig sig lan gsum bya zhes brjod/ rnga skad che ba gsum la rol pa/ de nas gzhi pad kyi pad skor gsum pa la ban phur brjes/ gzhi pad rdzogs pa dang / chung gsum la lag gnyis rol pa ltar brgyangs/ rkang g.yas g.yas zur mdun ngos su rting pa sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo btegs nas bgrad/ lag gnyis dang rkang g.yas bsdus la lag gnyis thugs kar mnyam/ rkang g.yas g.yon 'khris su sleb pa dang / rkang g.yas btegs/ lus cung zad 'phar/ rkang g.yas g.yas thad du rting pa btsugs la bzhag ban phur thugs kar ban nang du phur rtse bcug la mnyam pa'i ngang nas lus g.yas phyogs su rol mo che ba bzhi'i bar la gru mo gnyis thad kar brgyangs/ ro stod rgyab nas cung zad gcu zhing gsig rkang g.yon gyi rting pa de mthun bskor/ sgyid pa gnyis ldem/ rol mo rdzogs pa dang g.yas phyogs su 'gying la/ yang chung gsum la lag gnyis brgyangs nas rkang g.yon g.yon zur mdun ngos su rting pa sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo btegs nas bgrad/ lag gnyis dang rkang g.yon bsdus la lag gnyis thugs kar mnyam/ rkang g.yon g.yas 'khris su sleb pa dang / rkang g.yon btegs/ lus cung zad 'phar/

rkang g.yon g.yon thad du rting pa btsugs la bzhag ban phur thugs kar gong bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang nas g.yon phyogs su rol mo che bzhi'i bar la rkang g.yas kyi rting pa bskor ba ma gtogs gsig pa sogs lus kyi rnam 'gyur gong bzhin byas la/ g.yon phyogs su 'gying nas/ yang chung gsum la lag gnyis dang / rkang g.yas bsdu ba gong dang 'dra/ gsig pa'i dus g.yas g.yon gyi rting skor dang ro stod mdun rgyab tu gcu ba sogs thog mar g.yas/ de nas g.yon te g.yas g.yon re mos su che bzhi la bsigs la tshar ba dang lus cung zad g.yon phyogs 'gying zhing nem nas chung gsum gyi ring la rkang g.yas btegs/ mdun nas bskor zhing 'gro phyogs su bzhag la kha phyir blta/ de mthun lag g.yas g.yas phyogs nas cung zad g.yab pa'i tshul gyis rkang g.yas kyi pus mo'i steng du kha phub ste bzhag yang chung gsum la rkang g.yon btegs/ rgyab phyogs bskor zhing 'gro phyogs bzhag de mthun lag g.yon g.yon nas g.yab cing pad skor ltar bskor nas mthar pus mo g.yon gyi steng gan rkyal du bzhag lag g.yas phur rtse nam mkha' la phyar ba ste/ de la 'jol stabs zhes bya ste/ 'og tu 'jol stabs zhes pa rnams 'dis rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /de nas 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros skor gcig go/ ༈ /bdun pa dam nyams kyi bla dgug pa ni/ dam nyams kyi bla dgug par bya ba'i phyir mgo gug lan gsum bya zhes brjod nas rol mo che ba gsum la rol pa byas la/ gzhi pad nas rkang lag bsdu ba'i bar gong bzhin la ban phur brje mi dgos/ lag gnyis mnyam nas gsig pa'i dus/ lag gnyis sked gzer dang / mgo bo g.yas phyogs su rol mo dang bstun gug gug byed/ de bzhin g.yon gyi dus g.yon dang / g.yas g.yon gnyis ka la gsig dus re mos kyis mgo gug byed pa dang lag gnyis sked gzer byed pa tsam ma gtogs/ gzhan 'jol stabs 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/

skyod 'gros sogs gong bzhin bya ba'o// ༈ /brgyad pa srung ma rnams 'bod pa ni/ srung ma rnams 'bod par bya ba'i phyir bcug pa lan gsum 'don par bya zhes brjod nas che gsum la rol pa byas la/ dngos gzhi'i skabs su lag gnyis sked gzer gyi tshab thugs kar mnyam nas ban+dha'i rgyab tu phur rtse phyir bstan du bzung / g.yon pa'i mtheb mdzub kha'i thad du bcug pa 'debs tshul te lag gnyis kha'i sgor bsnol ba tsam ma gtogs/ rkang lag bsdu ba/ lus kyi 'gying dang gsig pa/ 'jol stabs/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros sogs tshul gzhan thams cad gong dang khyad par cung zad kyang med pa'o/<!TCC Tibetan character 4,99 undefined in unicode!>bdun pa dang brgyad pa phyag len la gong 'og spo ba mdzad// ༈ /dgu pa chos skyong la dpang 'dzugs par bya ba'i phyir 'o dod lan gsum 'bod pa 'di phyag len la mi mdzad pas bzhag go/ ༈ /bcu pa steng byin gyis brlab pa ni/ steng byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir gnam 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad du bri bar bya zhes brjod nas/ rol mo che gsum la rol pa byas la/ de nas gzhi bca' phyed ma bya tshul ni/ gzhi pad kyi pad skor bzhi pa g.yon gyi dus su rnga skad cung che ba gcig dang bstun rkang g.yas btegs nas rgyab tu bskyal/ lus g.yas phyogs su cung zad 'phar zhing gcu/ yang pad skor lnga pa dbus kyi pad skor dus rnga skad cung che ba dang rkang g.yon g.yon phyogs kyi rgyab tu bskyal/ lus g.yon phyogs su cung zad 'phar zhing gcu/ de nas lus kyi g.yas zur nang du bstan pa'i ngang nas ban phur rkang g.yas kyi pus steng du brkyangs te chung gsum la dzam bya/ gsum pa la sgyid ldem dang bcas lag g.yon sked pa la brten/ g.yas pas phur rtse nam mkha' la bstan/ rkang g.yas btegs nas rol mo che ba gcig la 'gying / de rjes che myur brgyad kyi bar la rkang stabs lag stabs de ga'i ngang nas phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi ste brgyad du phur rtse nam mkhar bstan/

de nas 'jol stabs/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros sogs gong bzhin bya ba'o// ༈ /bcu gcig pa bar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bar byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir logs bkra shis rtags brgyad du bri bar bya zhes brjod la/ gzhan 'cham tshul tshang ma gong dang 'dra ba las rol mo che myur brgyad kyi ring la phur rtse nam mkha' la ston pa'i tshab bar gyi logs brgyad la ston pa khyad par ro// ༈ /bcu gnyis pa 'og byin gyis brlab pa ni/ 'og byin gyis brlab par bya ba'i phyir sa pad+ma 'dab brgyad du bri bar bya zhes brjod la rol mo drag myur brgyad la phur rtse sa 'og la ston pa tsam ma gtogs/ skyod 'gros bar 'cham tshul tshang ma gong dang khyad par med do// ༈ /bcu gsum pa rdo rje phyed 'gros ni/ rdo rje phyed 'gros kyis sa btsal bar bya zhes brjod nas rol mo che ba gsum la rol pa/ de nas rnga bzhi rdung bya zhing / bzhi brdung chung snyoms gnyis gnyis la pad skor gong bzhin rdzogs pa'i 'phyong pad bya/ pad skor rting ma g.yas kyi dus bzhi brdung rting ma'i gsum dang / bzhi pa'i rnga skad che bar byas/ lus gsig shin tu che zhing rnga bzhi brdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas lag g.yas btegs/ mdun nas bskor zhing g.yon gyi rgyab zur du phab nas lag g.yon brkyangs pa'i ban nang du phur rtse bcug la rdo rje'i g.yon gyi ra bri/ yang bzhi brdung che ba gcig la rkang g.yas mdun gyi g.yon zur du bzhag ban+dha la phur pa bskor zhing pad skor tshul du byas la g.yas ra bri/ yang bzhi brdung che ba gcig la rkang g.yas ra gnyis kyi bar 'gro lam du bzhag lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol te dbus ra 'bri tshul bya/ ra rnams 'bri dus rkang g.yon g.yas pa'i rgyab tu btegs tsam re bya/ lus rol mo dang bstun gsig bzhi re bya/ de nas bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la lag gnyis sked par brten/ rkang g.yas mdun nas bskor la lte ba 'bri tshul bya zhing g.yas zur du bzhag

rkang g.yon gyi rting pa sa la btsugs rkang mgo btegs la 'gying / de nas rnga che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs la 'gro phyogs 'phyong zhing g.yas phab/ lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol/ che ba gcig la g.yon btegs/ lag gnyis dpung steng gnyis su gzing / de ga'i ngang nas bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon g.yas kyi mdun zur du phab/ ban nang du phur rtse bcug pa g.yas ra dang / yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon rgyab kyi g.yon zur du bzhag ban+dha la phur pa bskor ba gong bzhin gyis g.yon ra bri/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la ra gnyis kyi dbus su rkang g.yon bzhag lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol nas dbus ra 'bri tshul gong bzhin byas nas bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la lag gnyis sked par brten/ rkang g.yon rgyab nas bskor la lte ba 'bri tshul bya zhing / kha phyir bstan gyi g.yon zur du rkang g.yon phab/ rkang g.yas kyi rting pa sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo btegs la 'gying / 'phyong dus rkang g.yon sngon la gdeg pa ma gtogs gzhan khyad par med do/ /rdo rje'i ra 'bri skabs rkang g.yon sa la 'jog dus/ rkang g.yas btegs tsam re byed pa g.yas g.yon gyi khyad par ma gtogs gong dang 'dra/ de bzhin g.yas g.yon re mos kyis tshul du lan lnga drug skabs su gang bab bris tshar ba dang / rting ma'i sked gzer grub nas mi 'phyong bar lag stabs dang rnga skad chung ba de ga'i ngang nas bskor ba ji ltar rigs pa byed pa ste ldem 'gros so/ /'og tu ldem 'gros zhes pa 'dis shes par bya'o// ༈ /bcu bzhi pa rdo rje rkyang 'gros ni rdo rje rkyang 'gros kyis sa gdul bar bya zhes brjod/ de nas rnga bzhi rdeg che ba gnyis la g.yas gcus g.yon gcus kyis rol pa gnyis bya/ g.yas gcus la rkang pa g.yon gyi rting skor/ g.yon gcus la g.yas kyi rting skor byed pa ste rol pa thams cad la rigs 'gre/ de nas bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis re la pad skor re rdzogs pa'i gzhi pad kyi pad skor gsum pa'i rnga skad cung che ba dang bcas/

rkang g.yas rgyab tu bskyal/ kha g.yas phyogs su blta zhing dbus kyi pad skor bya/ yang rnga skad cung che ba dang bcas rkang g.yon rgyab tu bskyal/ kha g.yas phyogs su blta/ pad skor bzhi pa g.yon gyi pad skor bya/ yang rkang g.yas rgyab tu bskyal/ kha g.yas phyogs su blta/ pad skor lnga pa dbus kyi pad skor byed pa ste gzhi pad gzhi bca' tshang ma dang bcas pa'o/ /pad skor rdzogs pa dang / bzhi rdung rting ma'i gsum dang bzhi pa'i rnga skad che bar bya/ lus gsig shin tu che zhing rnga bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la g.yas phyogs la bltas pa de ga'i ngang nas rkang g.yas lag g.yas btegs/ rgyab phyogs nas bskor zhing g.yas mdun ngos su bzhag ban nang du phur rtse bcug ste g.yas ra bri/ de bzhin du bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ ban+dha la phur pa bskor ba sogs/ g.yon ra bri/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas ra gnyis kyi bar du bzhag dbus ra 'bri tshul dang lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol/ rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ rgyab nas bskor te 'gro phyogs phab/ yang rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ lag gnyis dpung steng gnyis su gzing / kha 'gro phyogs la blta/ rkang g.yon g.yas mdun du bzhag nas g.yas ra bri/ yang rkang g.yon btegs la rgyab zur bzhag nas g.yon ra bri/ yang rkang g.yon btegs nas ra gnyis kyi dbus su bzhag la dbus ra bri/ lag stabs gong dang 'dra/ de nas lag gnyis sked gzer byas/ rkang g.yon rgyab nas bskor la lte ba 'bri tshul bya zhing / kha phyir bstan gyi g.yon zur du rkang g.yon phab/ rkang g.yas kyi rting pa sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo btegs la cung zad 'gyings/ yang rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ rgyab nas bskor lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol zhing 'phyong la/ sngar bzhin kha g.yas phyogs bltas la rkang g.yon phab/ yang che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ lag gnyis dpung steng gnyis su gzings/

rkang g.yas g.yas mdun ngos su bzhag ste g.yas ra ste ra gsum 'bri ba 'gro phyogs 'phyong zhing rkang g.yon gyi ra gsum 'bri ba/ sked gzer bya zhing 'gying ba sogs gong bzhin dang 'dra/ de lta bu'i rdo rje rkyang pa gnyis gsum gang rigs bris tshar ba dang / rkang g.yon rgyab la bskor/ lte ba 'bri tshul gyi sked gzer de ga'i ngang la gong bzhin ldem 'gros bzhi rdeg byed do// ༈ /bco lnga pa rdo rje rgya gram ni/ rdo rje rgya gram sbal 'gros rigs kyis sa gzhi byin gyis brlab pa'o zhes brjod cing bzhi rdeg che ba gnyis la gong bzhin rol pa bya/ de nas rdo rje phyed 'gros bzhin 'phyong pad rdzogs pa dang lus bsigs shing bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ mdun gyi g.yon zur/ yang g.yas btegs mdun gyi g.yas zur/ yang rkang g.yas btegs/ de gnyis kyi bar du bzhag ste g.yas g.yon dbus gsum gyi ra 'bri tshul byed/ de nas rnga skad che ba gcig la lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol ba de ga'i ngang la rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas phyogs su bskor nas kha rgyab tu blta zhing rgyab phyogs su phab/ yang rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ lag gnyis dpung steng gnyis su gzings/ bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rgyab kyi g.yas zur du phab la g.yas ra dang / de bzhin du ra gzhan gnyis gong bzhin bri/ yang rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ rgyab nas bskor/ 'gro phyogs la rgyab bstan nas rkang g.yas kyi rdo rje'i ra gsum gong bzhin bri/ yang rkang g.yas btegs/ rgyab nas bskor la 'gro phyogs kyi ra gsum rkang g.yon gyis bri ba ste rdo rje rgya gram mo/ /bris tshar ba dang lag gnyis sked gzer byas/ rkang g.yon rgyab nas bskor la lte ba 'bri tshul cung zad 'gying ba sogs gong bzhin/ yang rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ rgyab nas bskor/ lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol zhing 'phyong la kha mdun la bltas nas rkang g.yon phab/

yang che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ lag gnyis dpung steng gnyis su gzings/ rkang g.yas kyis mdun gyi ra gsum bri/ yang 'phyong zhing rgyab kyi ra bri ba sogs gong bzhin rdo rje rgya gram gyi tshul du bri ba lan gsum la sogs pa skabs su gang bab bris tshar ba dang / lag gnyis sked gzer bya zhing mdun phyogs la 'phyong tshar ba dang ra mi 'bri bar bzhi rdeg chung ba'i ngang nas 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros skor gcig gong bzhin/ dzam gyi dus bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis la rdzogs par byed/ skyod 'gros byung tshad chig rdung yin/ rdo rje dang / me ri 'gros sogs ra 'bri tshad kyi dus rkang pa g.yas kyis 'bri dus g.yon dang / g.yon gyis 'bri dus g.yas btegs tsam re byed pa/ ra 'bri ba/ ldem 'gros sogs kyi bzhi rdeg dus lus gsig cing mgo gug yod tsam bya dgos so/ /de rnams kyis sngon 'gro don tshan bco lnga'i rim pa bstan zin to// ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang / brten pa lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po chos 'byung rlung chu me/ /sa dang rak+ta keng rus dang / /gzhal yas khang bskyed rnam brgyad do/ /zhes pa ltar don tshan brgyad las/ dang po chos 'byung bskyed pa ni/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /zhes brjod/ de nas gong bzhin rnga che ba gsum la rol pa byas nas rnga bzhi rdeg gong rdo rje 'bri skabs bzhin la/ cung mi 'dra ba ni pad skor gyi chung ba dang / dngos gzhi'i che ba gnyis ka la bzhi rdeg gi dang po che ba/ gnyis pa/ gsum pa/ bzhi pa gsum chung ba ste che skad chung skad dod pa bya/ bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis gnyis la pad skor byed pa 'dra/ de bzhin gyi gzhi pad byas/ pad skor rting ma lnga pa dbus kyi pad skor tshar ba dang / lag gnyis mtheb mdzub gshibs nas lus kyi dbus su sbyar nas g.yon phyogs brkyangs shing mdun nas bskor te g.yas kyi nu kha brgyud dbus su sleb pa'i tshul gyis bzhi rdeg chung ba re la/

de ltar byas pa'i dzam lan gnyis tshar ba dang / lus gsig cing sgyid ldem che ba gcig byas/ rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ lus 'phar zhing mdun ngos gang sleb tu bzhag de bzhin lag g.yas thugs kha nas phar brgyangs/ phur dar dkrugs shing rkang g.yas gar 'gro'i sar phyar te chos 'byung gi mdun gyi zur dang / yang rnga skad che ba gcig la lus 'phar ba dang bcas rkang g.yon btegs 'gro phyogs g.yon zur du bzhag lag g.yon ban+dha phyar tshul gyis rkang g.yon bar brgyangs la chos 'byung gi g.yon zur dang / rkang gnyis bgrad/ lag gnyis brgyangs pa de ga'i ngang nas bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la g.yas phyogs su lus gsig shin tu che zhing / sked pa mnyen zhing / lag pa g.yas sa la reg la khad bya zhing 'gyings/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la g.yon phyogs su gong bzhin gsig lag g.yon dang sked pa sogs gong bzhin ngos/ g.yon 'gying che ba byed/ de nas lag g.yon dku la brten/ g.yas phur rtses chos 'byung 'bri tshul dang / rkang g.yas brkyangs sa la ri mo 'bri ba'i tshul gyis bsdus/ rkang g.yon thad du sleb pa dang / yang rnga skad che ba gcig la lus bsigs shing 'phar ba dang bcas rkang g.yas mdun nas g.yas phyogs la bskor zhing g.yas zur du bzhag lag g.yas brgyangs pa sogs gong dang 'dra bas chos 'byung gi g.yas zur dang / yang rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon lag g.yon btegs/ sngar gyi rkang g.yas kyi shul chos 'byung gi mdun zur du bzhag la/ bzhi rdeg che ba gnyis la lag gnyis brgyang / g.yas g.yon du gsig cing 'gying lugs lag g.yon dku la brten/ g.yas kyi phur rtses sa la 'bri tshul rkang stabs sogs gong dang 'dra ba tshar nas/ yang rkang g.yas btegs lus gsig pa dang bcas pas rnga skad che ba gcig la chos 'byung gi g.yon zur sngar gyi rkang g.yon gyi shul du bzhag yang rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ chos 'byung gi g.yas zur rkang g.yas shul du bzhag nas/

kha rgyab la bltas te lag gnyis brgyangs g.yas g.yon du gsig cing 'gying ba/ phur rtses bri zhing rkang pa bsdus pa rol mo sogs gong dang 'dra ste chos 'byung rtse nang bstan no/ /bsdus tshar ba dang / kha rgyab la bstan pa de ga'i ngang nas bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis kyi ring la rkang g.yas btegs/ lag g.yas g.yas phyogs nas cung zad g.yab pa'i tshul gyis rkang g.yas kyi pus mo'i steng kha phub ste bzhag yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis la rkang g.yon drud nas rgyab phyogs bskor zhing 'gro phyogs bzhag de mthun lag g.yon g.yon nas g.yab cing pad skor ltar bskor nas mthar pus mo g.yon gyi steng gan rkyal du bzhag lag g.yas phur dar dang phur rtse nam mkha' la phyar/ kha mdun du blta/ de nas bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis la pad skor gcig byas la dzam nas brtsams te kha mdun du lta ba'i bar gong bzhin chos 'byung bri ba lan gsum la sogs pa skabs su gang bab tshar ba dang / rdo rje'i skabs bzhin bzhi rdung gi 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros ni gcig rdeg skor gcig go/ ༈ /gnyis pa rlung gi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /zhes brjod nas gong bzhin rol pa gsum bya/ de nas rnga lnga rdeg tu bsgyur la/ rnga lnga rdeg chung ba gnyis la pad skor re rdzogs pa'i gzhi pad bya/ rdzogs pa dang gong bzhin lag gnyis snying gar mtheb mdzub sbyar nas dzam bya ba ni/ snying ga nas lag gnyis ma bral bar rnga skad chung ba lnga la g.yon phyogs nas mdun la bskor/ g.yas phyogs su sleb pa dang lnga zhes pa'i dus rol mo cung che ba dang bcas lag gnyis g.yas zur du gshibs nas brgyang / yang lnga rdeg chung ba lnga la mdun nas bskor ba gong bzhin byas la g.yas phyogs su sleb pa dang / gong bzhin rol mo lnga zhes pa cung che ba gcig bya/ lag gnyis shed bskyed pa'i tshul gyis g.yas kyi rgyab phyogs su brgyang /

lus po yang rgyab phyogs su gcu tsam dang / sgyid ldem che ba gcig byas la/ lag g.yon sked gzer byas/ lag g.yas nam mkha' la brgyangs te rnga skad che ba lnga'i bar la mdun la bskor zhing / rkang g.yas kyis sa la 'od gzhu'i tshul zla gam du bri zhing kha rgyab phyogs la blta/ yang chung ba lnga'i bar lag g.yas thur la brkyang / g.yon pa sked gzer de ga'i ngang nas rkang g.yon rgyab nas bskor zhing drang por 'then la gzhu rgyud 'bri ba'i tshul gyis kha mdun la blta/ yang lnga zhes pa che ba gcig dang bstun lus nem pa dang bcas pas rnga skad che ba lnga la lag g.yon sked gzer 'cham tshul ma rdzogs bar de ga'i ngang nas yin zhing / lag g.yas gzhu 'bri dus nam mkhar brgyang / rgyud 'bri dus thur la brkyang pa yin pas nam mkhar brgyangs te phyir rgyab phyogs su bskor/ rkang g.yas kyis rgyab phyogs su gong bzhin gzhu bri/ yang chung ba lnga'i bar la rkang g.yon mdun nas drang por 'then la gzhu rgyud bri/ tshul de bzhin gsum mam lnga'am bdun la sogs pa bskyar nas byas tshar ba dang / 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros gcig rdeg skor gcig bya ba ni rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa lta bu zhes pa'o// ༈ /gsum pa chu'i dkyil 'khor ni/ de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /zhes brjod nas gong bzhin rol pa gsum dang / de nas rnga lnga rdeg gi gzhi pad dang / dzam gyi bca' thabs gong dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas phyogs su mi 'jog par bskor la lnga zhes pa'i dus rol mo cung che ba dang bcas lag gnyis g.yon zur du gshibs nas brgyang / yang lnga rdeg chung ba la lnga la mdun nas bskor ba gong bzhin byas la g.yon phyogs su sleb pa dang / gong bzhin rol mo lnga zhes pa cung che ba gcig byas/ lag gnyis shed bskyed pa'i tshul gyis g.yon gyi rgyab phyogs su brgyang / lus po yang rgyab phyogs su gcus tsam dang / sgyid ldem che ba gcig byas la/

lag g.yon sked gzer byas la/ lag g.yas nam mkha' la brgyangs te rnga skad che ba lnga'i bar la mdun nas rgyab phyogs g.yas skor du bskor nas 'gro phyogs la kha blta zhing rkang g.yas kyis sa la zlum po'i tshul gyis bri/ yang chung ba lnga'i bar la lag gnyis sked gzer byas rkang g.yon sa la zlum po 'bri ba'i tshul gyis gong gi skor ba phyir log lan gyis tshul du bskor/ g.yon zur du rkang g.yon sleb pa dang lnga zhes pa'i dus rol mo cung che ba dang bcas lus cung zad nem la rnga skad che ba gnyis la lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol zhing 'gro phyogs 'phyong ba dang / lag gnyis dpung steng du gzing ba sogs gong rdo rje 'bri ba'i skabs bzhin byas la/ yang rnga skad chung ba la pad skor dang dzam nas brtsams te 'phyong ba'i bar gong bzhin bskyar nas gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa skabs dang sbyar nas bya/ de nas 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros gcig rdeg gong bzhin ji ltar rigs par bya ba ni/ chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po zhes pa'o// ༈ /bzhi pa me'i dkyil 'khor ni/ raṃ las me byung bskyod pa de yi phyed/ /zhes brjod nas gong bzhin rol pa gsum bya/ de nas rnga skad rdo rje 'gros bzhin bzhi rdung ngos/ 'phyong pad byas la rdzogs pa'i bzhi rdung rting ma'i gsum dang bzhi pa'i rnga skad che bar byas lus gsig shin tu che zhing rnga bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas lag g.yas btegs/ g.yas kyi mdun zur du rkang g.yas bzhag lag gnyis pad skor bya/ de bzhin du yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs 'gro phyogs g.yon zur du phab/ pad skor bya/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas kyi rgyab zur du bzhag lag gnyis sked gzer bya ba ste gru gsum ltar 'gro phyogs su rtse bstan pa yin/ de nas rdo rje ltar 'phyong zhing yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ 'gro phyogs bzhag

lag gnyis pad skor bya/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas kyi mdun zur du phab/ pad skor bya/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ g.yas kyi rgyab zur du bzhag lag gnyis sked gzer bya/ kha phyir bstan/ yang gong bzhin 'phyong ba ste de lta bu g.yas g.yon re mos kyis bskyar nas lnga drug gang rigs bya zhing rdzogs pa dang / 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros bzhi rdeg bya ba ste me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum gyi tshul lo// ༈ /lnga pa sa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ laṃ las sa yi dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /zhes brjod nas bzhi rdeg che ba gnyis la rdo rje rkyang 'gros bzhin rol pa bya/ gong me bzhin 'phyong pad byas la rdo rje bzhin bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs g.yon gyi rgyab zur du bzhag ban nang du phur rtse bcug yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yon gyi mdun zur du bzhag pad skor bya/ de nas bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas rkang g.yon 'khris su bsdu zhing nam mkhar 'phar la rkang gnyis 'gro lam gyi dbus su mnyam/ lag gnyis phrag gong du phyar/ yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs la rgyab nas bskor/ lus gcus te g.yas kyi rgyab zur ngos su rtse mo btsugs/ g.yas kyi sta zur steng du phur rtse ban nang du bcug yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ g.yas kyi rgyab g.yon zur du bzhag lus kyi g.yon zur du pad skor bya/ de nas bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon rkang g.yas 'khris su bsdu zhing nam mkhar 'phar la rkang gnyis 'gro lam gyi dbus su mnyam/ lag gnyis g.yab cing sked gzer bya/ de nas rdo rje bzhin 'phyong la/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ g.yon gyi mdun zur du phab cing ban nang du phur rtse bcug yang rkang g.yon btegs bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la g.yon gyi rgyab zur du bzhag

pad skor bya/ de nas rkang g.yon bsdus rkang gnyis dkyil du mnyam pa lag gnyis phyar zhing gzing ba gong bzhin/ yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas kyi rgyab zur du rtse mo btsugs/ lus cung zad gcus/ sta zur g.yon gyi steng du ban nang du phur rtse bcug yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas kyi mdun zur du bzhag lag gnyis lus kyi g.yas zur du pad skor bya/ rkang g.yas bsdu/ dbus su rkang gnyis mnyam pa lag gnyis g.yab cing sked gzer byas nas gong bzhin 'phyong / yang g.yas kyis 'bri ba sogs g.yas g.yon re mos kyis lan gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa bskyar nas bya/ 'di'i skabs kyi g.yas zur mdun rgyab g.yon zur mdun rgyab ces pa kha do ra'i mdun la bltas pa gzhir bzhag gis lus kyi g.yas g.yon la cha bzhag pa yin/ gru bzhi zur bzhi ni 'gro phyogs su g.yas kyi gnyis dang / de'i lan g.yon gyi rgyab tu gnyis bri ba de bzhi yin/ de nas 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros bzhi rdeg ste sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi'i tshul lo// ༈ /drug pa rak+ta ni/ de steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrug /ces brjod nas rol pa gnyis dang 'phyong pad gong bzhin byas la rdzogs zhes bzhi rdeg rting ma'i gsum bzhi gnyis rnga skad che bar byas lus nem zhing g.yas su gcu/ de mthun lag gnyis g.yas su brkyang / bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas mdun nas bskor zhing rkang g.yon gyi pus steng tsam du btegs/ lus dkrug brdabs kyis g.yon phyogs su gcus/ lag gnyis gan rkyal du brkyangs pa rak+ta'i rba klong g.yo pa'i tshul gyis lus sgur nas lag gnyis rtse mo sa la reg la khad cig g.yon nas rna ba g.yon pa'i thad du phyar zhing lus bsrang / yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yas dang lag gnyis rim pas phab ste 'gro phyogs su bzhag yang che ba bzhi la rkang g.yon mdun nas bskor zhing g.yas pa'i pus steng tsam du btegs/

lus dkrug brdabs kyis g.yas phyogs su gcus/ lag gnyis gan rkyal du brkyangs pa rak+ta'i rba klong g.yo pa'i tshul gyis lus sgur nas lag gnyis rtse mo sa la reg la khad cig g.yo nas rna ba g.yas pa'i thad du phyar zhing lus bsrang / yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yon dang lag gnyis rim pas phab ste 'gro phyogs su bzhag yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la kha 'gro phyogs lta bzhin pas rkang g.yas g.yon gyi pus steng tsam du mdun du btegs/ lag gnyis gan rkyal du brkyangs pa rak+ta'i rba klong g.yo pa'i tshul gyis lus mdun du sgur nas lag gnyis rtse mo sa la reg la khad cig g.yon nas smin mtshams kyi thad du phyar zhing lus bsrang / yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yas dang lag gnyis rim pas phab ste 'gro phyogs bzhag yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon dang lag gnyis g.yas phyogs g.yo pa sogs gong bzhin g.yas g.yon re mos kyis tshul du g.yas g.yon dbus gsum ka tshang ba ni rak+ta'i rba klong 'khrug pa ste tshul de bzhin lan lnga'am bdun la sogs pa bya/ de ltar rdzogs pa dang / 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros bzhi rdeg bya ba'o// ༈ /bdun pa keng rus ni/ dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsigs pa'i steng / /zhes brjod nas rol pa gnyis dang 'phyong pad gong bzhin byas la/ bzhi rdung che ba gcig la rak+ta bzhin lus dkrugs shing 'gro phyogs su gcu ba 'dra/ rkang g.yas btegs/ lag g.yon sked gzer/ lag g.yas g.yab cing pus mo'i steng du kha phub la rkang g.yas sa la bzhag yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ rgyab la bskor lag gnyis gar stabs kyis dpung g.yon steng du g.yon mtho zhing phyar/ g.yas g.yon pa'i gre mo'i thad du btsugs la kha phyir blta/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs pa de ga'i ngang nas sngar shul du log la 'gro phyogs bzhag lag gnyis bskor la g.yon gyi pus steng gan rkyal du bzhag

yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas g.yas ngos la btegs kha mdun la bltas/ lag gnyis gar stabs kyis g.yas dpung g.yas steng du phyar/ g.yon g.yas kyi gru mo la btsugs/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs pa de ga'i ngang la sngar shul du log la 'gro phyogs phab/ gong bzhin lag g.yon sked gzer g.yas pus steng bkab/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs/ rgyab la bskor zhing lag gnyis gar stabs sogs gong bzhin byas la bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yon sngar bzhin 'gro phyogs phab/ lag gnyis dpral bar thal mo sbyar la kha mdun du blta/ yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la lag gnyis dpral ba nas lte ba tsam rim pas phab pa ste keng rus gar byed kyi tshul lo/ /de lta bu bskyar nas lan bcu gcig sogs rol mo bzhi rdeg drag cing myur ba la 'cham gyi lhu ma shor ba'i bde nyams shin tu che ba bya zhing rdzogs pa dang / bzhi rdeg de ga'i ngang nas 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros gcig rdeg skor gcig go/ ༈ /brgyad pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ rin chen lnga las grub pa'i gzhal med khang / /zhes brjod/ gong bzhin rol pa gsum/ de nas rnga skad che chung spel ba'i 'theng rkang du bsgyur la 'theng rkang gsum gsum la pad skor rdzogs pa'i 'phyong pad byas te rting ma'i 'theng rkang gsum pa la rol mo cung che bar bya/ lus g.yas su nem zhing lag g.yon ban nang du rdul tshon 'khyer ba'i tshul gyis kha gyen du bstan la sked pa g.yon la brten/ g.yas kyi rdul tshon sa gzhi thams cad la 'grems pa'i tshul gyis rdul tshon g.yon gyi ban nang nas blangs/ g.yas phyogs la 'thor ba'i rnam pas phur dar g.yon dang g.yas la dkrug pa dang / thog mar rkang g.yas btegs pa'i g.yas g.yon re mos kyis 'gro phyogs la rgyab mdun du 'phyong zhing gral gyi phreng ba bar thag snyoms la ma chad pa/ sked pa g.yas g.yon du ldem shin tu che zhing dod pa'i ngang la skor ba tshang ma gcig bya/

de nas kha do ra'i mdun la blta zhing gong bzhin 'phyong pad byas la/ lag g.yon dpral bar ban+dha kha phyir bstan du bzung la rdul tshon bkram pa rnams snyoms mi snyoms bya ra blta ba'i tshul dang / g.yas dang rkang stabs gong bzhin gyis 'phyong la 'cham dpon phyogs shar gyi dbus su phebs pa dang / dpon slob tshang ma zhal phyir bstan gyi shar sgo 'bri tshul bya ste/ de yang lag gnyis mtheb mdzub sbyar nas dpung pa gnyis kyi thad tsam nas mdun la brkyangs te rol mo 'theng rkang gcig la sgo 'gram/ de nas g.yas g.yon du phyir khru gang tsam re 'then la/ 'theng rkang gcig bya ste sgo 'khyog de nas 'theng rkang gcig la lag gnyis de ga'i ngang nas gyen la khru re tsam btegs pa sgo logs/ de nas 'theng rkang gcig la lag gnyis bsdu ba'i tshul gyis smin mtshams kyi thad tsam du sor mo'i rtse sprad pa sgo'i ya phubs so/ /de nas 'theng rkang gsum la rkang g.yas btegs/ mdun nas bskor zhing 'gro phyogs su bzhag de mthun lag g.yas cung zad g.yab pa'i tshul gyis g.yas kyi pus steng kha phub bzhag yang 'theng rkang gsum la rkang g.yon btegs/ rgyab phyogs bskor zhing 'gro phyogs bzhag lag g.yon g.yab cing pad skor ltar bskor nas pus mo g.yon steng gan rkyal du bzhag pa 'jol stabs te sgo 'bri tshul nas 'di'i bar gyi rol mo 'theng rdung rnams shin tu chung zhing 'theng rkang rjes ma la che ba gcig rdeg sgyid ldem dang / sked pa g.yon phyogs ldem shin tu che zhing lag g.yas dpung g.yas steng du phyar la/ yang 'theng rkang drag cing myur ba dang bstun lag stabs rkang stabs gong bzhin byas la 'phyong zhing shar lho'i gru bzhi'i zur la blta ba'i tshul gyis bskor la lho phyogs kyi dbus su sleb pa dang / zhal phyir bstan gyis lho sgo 'bri tshul/ 'jol stabs grub rjes 'phyong ba rnams gong dang 'dra bar byas la lho nub kyi zur la blta ba'i tshul gyis bskor te nub kyi dbus su phebs pa dang /

nub sgo 'bri tshul sogs gong dang 'dra zhing / 'phyong nas nub byang gi zur bskor/ byang gi dbus su phebs pa dang byang sgo 'bri tshul sogs 'dra zhing byang shar gyi zur thog ma'i 'phro cung zad yod pa/ thog ma skor mtshams su ma phebs bar 'phyong tshar ba dang / dpon slob tshang ma zhal do ra'i nang la gzigs nas 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros gcig rdeg skor gcig ste rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'o// ༈ /don gnyis pa brten pa rtsa ba'i lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig bskyed pa las/ gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa ni/ dpal chen po'i 'gying chen 'gying chung / dbu gsum rdzogs tshul du bskyed pa/ phyag drug bskyed pa/ zhabs bzhi bskyed pa/ dpal gyi chas brgyad bskyed pa/ rdo rje'i khyung gshog bskyed pa/ 'khril sbyor yum gyi phyag rgya ste don tshan brgyad las/ dang po 'gying chen ni/ dpal chen po'i 'gying che zhes brjod la rol mo gcig rdung gi rol pa gsum/ gzhi pad sogs 'cham tshul tshang ma sngon 'gro'i mkha' 'gro dpal bskyed pa dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas gsig bzhi song mtshams rnga skad chung gsum la rkang g.yas btegs mdun nas bskor zhing 'gro phyogs su bzhag la kha phyir bltas/ lag pa g.yas g.yab cing pad skor tshul du bskor la pus mo g.yas pa'i steng du gan rkyal du bzhag yang chung gsum la rkang g.yon btegs shing lag g.yon pad skor ltar bskor ba sogs 'jol stabs bzhin byed pa ste grol bsdu zhes bya ba ste 'og tu grol bsdu zhes pa 'dis rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /yang chung gsum la pad skor gcig byas/ rkang g.yon bsdus te g.yon gsig bzhi'i rjes la lag g.yon bskor ba dang rkang g.yon btegs te 'gro phyogs bzhag pa/ yang rkang g.yas btegs shing lag g.yas bskor zhing pus mo g.yas pa'i steng bzhag rkang g.yas rol mo gnyis pa'i dus 'gro phyogs bzhag cing / rol mo rjes ma'i gsum pa'i dus rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs bzhag la kha nang du blta/

yang gong bzhin pad skor gcig byas la rkang g.yas bsdus te g.yas g.yon gnyis ka la gsig pa'i rjes su grol bsdu byas la 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros gcig rdeg 'di'i rol mo dang 'cham tshul shin tu dal bar bya'o// ༈ /gnyis pa 'gying chung ni/ dpal chen po'i 'gying chung zhes brjod/ rol pa nas ldem 'gros bar gyi 'cham tshul thams cad gong dang 'dra ba las lag gnyis thugs kar mi bsnol bar sked gzer rol mo dang 'cham tshul gong las cung zad myur bar byed pa khyad par ro// ༈ /gsum pa dbu gsum bskyed pa ni/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /zhes brjod/ rol pa gsum dang gzhi pad byas la/ chung gsum la gong bzhin rkang g.yas sogs bsdus/ thugs kar mnyam pa dang ban phur gshibs nas lag g.yas kyis ban+dha'i mtha' nas bzung la rna ba g.yas kyi thad du cung zad drud cing g.yas gsig pa bzhi byed pa g.yas zhal dkar po dang / yang grol bsdu dang pad skor grub nas rkang g.yas sogs bsdus/ thugs kar mnyam pa dang ban phur rna ba g.yon gyi thad du gong bzhin g.yon gsig bzhi byed pa g.yon zhal dmar po/ yang g.yon gyi grol bsdu dang pad skor tshar nas rkang g.yas sogs bsdus la ban phur smin mtshams kyi thad nas sna rtser cung zad 'drud pa'i tshul gyis g.yas g.yon du gsig pa bzhi ste dbus zhal mthing kha ste zhal gsum bskyed nas grol bsdu dang / 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros skor gcig go/ ༈ /bzhi pa phyag drug bskyed pa ni/ rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me phung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gis bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur bsgril sku che rags/ /zhes brjod/ gong bzhin rol pa dang gzhi pad byas la/ chung gsum la rkang g.yas dang lag gnyis bsdu tshul gong bzhin thugs kar mnyam pa dang / lag g.yon sked gzer/ lag g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu phyar stabs kyis mtho bar dpung g.yas kyi nam mkhar btegs la/

g.yas gsig bzhi dang grol bsdu gong bzhin bya/ phyag gzhan rnams la yang pad skor grol bsdu sogs 'dra ba las g.yas gnyis pa bsdus tshar ba dang / lag g.yon sked gzer dang / lag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis sta zur g.yas pa'i 'og tsam du brkyangs la gsig pa bzhi sogs bya/ yang pad skor dang / g.yon bsdus tshar nas/ lag g.yas sked gzer dang / g.yon gyi dpung steng lag g.yon mtho bar phyar nas me phung 'dzin tshul dang g.yon gsig bzhi sogs bya/ yang pad skor dang g.yon gnyis pa bsdus te lag g.yon sta zur g.yon pa'i 'og tsam du brkyangs la rtse gsum 'dzin tshul dang / g.yas sked gzer dang gsig pa bzhi sogs bya/ yang pad skor dang rkang g.yas bsdus te ban+dha phyang phrul la bzhag lag gnyis phur pa bsgril zhing g.yas gsig g.yon gsig bzhi tshar ba dang / grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros skor gcig bya ba'o// ༈ /lnga pa zhabs bzhi bskyed pa ni/ zhabs bzhi g.yas bskums g.yon brkyangs nas/ /dbang phyug kha phub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab tu brdzis/ /zhes brjod/ rol pa dang gzhi pad gong bzhin byas la/ chung gsum la rkang g.yas dang lag gnyis bsdus thugs kar mnyam pa dang / che bzhi la lag gnyis pus mo g.yas dang g.yon gyi steng du re mos kyis brkyangs/ lus kyang g.yas gcus g.yon gcus kyis bsigs shing 'gying tshar ba dang / grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros skor gcig go/ ༈ /drug pa dpal gyi chas brgyad bskyed pa la gsum gyis/ dang po gdags pa'i rgyan gnyis kyis/ dang po la thod pa skam rlon gnyis thod pa rigs 'gre'i tshul gyis grangs gcig tu bzung ba yin/ don 'cham tshul gnyis te/ dang po thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /zhes brjod/ rol pa gsum dang gzhi pad byas nas chung gsum la rkang g.yas dang lag gnyis bsdus thugs kar mnyam pa dang / ban phur gshibs nas lag g.yas kyis ban+dha'i mtha' nas bzung la che ba lnga la rna ltag g.yas dang /

de'i 'khris kyi g.yon du reg cing cung zad drud/ kha g.yon la blta zhing g.yas phyogs gsig pa gnyis/ de bzhin du g.yon gyi rna ltag dang / de'i g.yas 'khris su gong bzhin drud/ kha g.yas la blta zhing g.yon gsig gnyis dang / dpral bar drud cing dbus su gsig pa ste lnga'o/ /de nas grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros skor gcig go/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ thod rlon lnga bcus do shal byas/ /zhes brjod/ rol pa dang gzhi pad gong bzhin/ chung gsum la lag gnyis ban+dha'i skra nas bzung ste rna ba g.yon gyi thad du lag g.yon mtho zhing g.yas dma' bas dzam gsum byas la/ che ba drug la de nas dal bus pho ba'i mtha' nas bskor zhing lus gsig cing g.yas kyi rna ba'i thad du sleb pa dang / chung gsum la lag g.yas mtho ba/ g.yon pa dma' bas bzung ste dzam gsum bya/ che ba drug la gsig cing sngar shul du log nas g.yon du sleb pa dang / grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros skor gcig go/ ༈ /gdags pa'i rgyan gsum pa sbrul rgyan ni/ dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /zhes brjod/ rol pa dang gzhi pad gong bzhin byas la/ chung gsum la lag gnyis ban phur dpung pa g.yas g.yon gyi thad du cung zad thur du 'phyang ba'i tshul gyis bzung nas dzam bya/ de nas lus g.yas dang g.yon du cung zad bsgyur zhing che ba lnga la lag gnyis rim pas nu ma gnyis/ sked pa/ pho ba sogs kyi mtha' nas bskor te sgying ldem dang bcas pas lus che bar gsig rol mo lnga pa la lag gnyis lte ba'i 'og tu bsnol zhing bskor ba sbrul mdud kyi tshul du byas la lag gnyis dkrol te lus bsrangs nas grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros skor gcig go/ ༈ /don tshan gnyis pa byug pa'i rdzas gsum ni/ rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyis/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur bris/ /zhes brjod/ rol pa dang gzhi pad gong bzhin byas la/ chung gsum la lag g.yon ban nang du rak+ta thugs kar 'dzin tshul dang /

g.yas kyi mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo gzhan gsum po bsgrengs la ban+dha'i mtha' bskor zhing / rol mo gsum pa cung che ba la lus sgyid ldem che zhing gsig sor mo gsum gyis ban nang nas rak+ta len tshul byas la lus g.yas gcus g.yon gcus ngos bsigs shing rnga skad che ba lnga la gung mo'i rtse mo smin mtshams dang / mdzub mo mkhur tshos g.yas/ srin mdzub g.yon/ yang gung mdzub ma le/ gsum kas sna rtser reg cing bsigs tshar ba dang / yang chung gsum la grol bsdu bya ste byug pa'i rdzas gsum gyi grol bsdu ni gzhan 'dra ba las lag g.yas bskor dus phur pa'i rtse phyir bstan kho na ma gtogs rang gi lus phyogs la rtse cung zad ma byung ba byed pa phur skor zhes bya ste khyad par de tsam mo/ /yang pad skor gcig dang chung gsum la lag g.yon gong bzhin ban nang du zhag 'dzin tshul dang / g.yas kyi mthe bos mthe'u chung dang mdzub mo mnan/ gung mo dang srin mdzub bsgrengs la ban+dha'i mtha' bskor zhing rol mo gsum pa cung che ba la gong bzhin bsigs shing ban nang nas zhag len tshul byas la lus g.yas gcus g.yon gcus ngos/ /rnga skad che ba bzhi la mdzub mo dang srin mdzub gnyis g.yas kyi nu ma'i steng nas g.yon gyi nu ma'i bar thad kar 'then la g.yon zur nas g.yas kyi nu ma'i zur gyi bar zla gam gyi tshul du zhag 'byug pa'i tshul bya/ de nas phur skor gyi grol bsdu gong bzhin/ yang pad skor dang chung gsum la lag g.yon ban nang du thal chen 'dzin tshul dang / gong rak+ta bzhin sor mo gsum gyis thal chen len tshul byas la/ lus gcu zhing gsig pa gong bzhin la rnga skad che ba bzhi la gung mdzub dpral ba'i dbus skra mtshams su thig le dang / mdzub mo smin ma g.yas srin mdzub g.yon gyi steng du dbu chen gyi na ro ltar ri mo 'then tshul dang gsum kas smin mtshams su tshom bu bya zhing bsigs la phur skor gyi grol bsdu/

'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros skor gcig go/ ༈ /don tshan brgyad du byas pa'i gsum pa bgo ba'i gos gsum ni/ glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi lpags pa'i 'og lpags can/ /zhes brjod/ de nas rol pa dang gzhi pad song nas/ dang po glang lpags ni chung gsum la lag g.yas kyis ban+dha'i skra nas bzung ste dpung g.yas steng du lag g.yas cung mtho zhing g.yon dma' bar byas la dzam bya zhing rol mo gsum pa cung che ba la rkang g.yas btegs la g.yas phyogs 'phyong zhing sa la bzhag g.yon gyis rting skor ngos g.yas phyogs gsig pa bzhi bya/ yang lag gnyis brgyangs pa de ka'i ngang nas chung gsum la rkang g.yon bsdu zhing rkang g.yas 'khris su sleb pa dang / rkang g.yon btegs nas 'phar zhing g.yon 'gro phyogs bzhag g.yas rting skor ngos/ g.yon phyogs gsig pa bzhi bya/ yang lag gnyis de ga'i ngang nas chung gsum la rkang g.yas bsdus g.yon 'khris su sleb pa dang / g.yas phyogs 'phyong zhing bzhag g.yas g.yon rting skor re mos ngos che bzhi la g.yas gsig g.yon gsig byas la grol bsdu bya/ gnyis pa zhing lpags ni/ yang pad skor gcig dang chung gsum la lag gnyis ban+dha'i skra shin tu ring ba gnyis nas bzung ste dpung g.yas steng du lag pa mtho dma' gong bzhin gyis dzam bya zhing rol mo gsum pa cung che ba la rkang g.yas btegs la g.yon zur 'gro phyogs su 'phyong zhing bzhag ban+dha zhwa thebs sogs la ma thogs par rgyab la bskyur zhing / kha phyir bstan ngos lag gnyis lpags mo brgyangs pa'i tshul gyis ban skra nam mkha' la phyar zhing g.yon gyi rting skor dang bstun che bzhi la g.yas gsig che bar bya/ yang lag stabs de ga'i ngang nas chung gsum la rkang g.yas kyi rtse mo sa la drud nas sngar shul du log cing g.yas phyogs sleb pa dang kha nang bltas kyis che bzhi la rkang g.yon rting skor dang bstun/ yang g.yas phyogs gsig yang lag gnyis sngar bzhin dang rkang g.yon bsdus tshar ba dang /

btegs nas g.yon du 'gro phyogs 'phyong zhing bzhag che bzhi la rting skor re mos ngos g.yas g.yon du bsigs nas grol bsdu bya/ gsum pa stag lpags ni/ pad skor gcig byas la chung gsum la lag g.yas ban skra nas bzung / sta zur g.yas su lag pa g.yas g.yon mtho dma' gong bzhin gyis dzam bya/ che bzhi la lus g.yas g.yon cung zad gcu zhing stag lpags kyi smad sham gyon pa'i tshul gyis sked pa man la bskor zhing g.yon gyi sta zur du sleb pa dang grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros skor gcig go /de dag ni dpal gyi chas brgyad bskyed pa'o// ༈ /bdun pa ni/ rdo rje'i khyung gshog /ces brjod/ rol pa dang gzhi pad gong bzhin dang / chung gsum la rkang g.yas g.yas zur mdun du brkyangs/ rting pa sa la btsugs/ lag gnyis brgyangs te rkang g.yas dang / lag gnyis rim gyis bsdu/ rkang g.yas g.yon thad du sleb shing / lag gnyis thugs kar mnyam pa dang / rkang g.yas btegs g.yas su 'phyong zhing lag gnyis khyung gshog ltar mtho dma' med par brgyangs/ rting skor g.yas g.yon re mos kyis g.yas g.yon du gsig cing g.yon rdzogs pa dang lus nem zhing 'gying la grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros skor gcig go/ ༈ /brgyad pa 'khril sbyor yum gyi phyag rgya ni/ yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /zhes brjod/ rol pa dang gzhi pad song nas chung gsum la gong bzhin rkang g.yas dang lag gnyis bsdus la mnyam pa dang / ban phur gshibs g.yas kyi ban+dha nas bzung / gong gi dbus zhal 'bri ba ltar che bzhi la g.yas gsig g.yon gsig dang / grol bsdu bya/ yang pad skor gcig byas/ chung gsum la lag gnyis rkang g.yas bsdus gong bzhin mnyam pa dang / rkang g.yas btegs nas g.yas zur du bzhag lag g.yon sked gzer dang / g.yas 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis g.yas nas bskor dpung pa g.yon gyi steng du sleb shing gsig pa/

rkang g.yon rting skor sogs che bzhi la byas nas g.yas phyogs 'gyings/ yang grol bsdu dang pad skor byas nas chung gsum la rkang g.yon bsdu zhing rkang g.yas 'khris su sleb pa dang / rkang g.yon btegs lus 'phar zhing g.yon phyogs bzhag lag g.yas sked gzer dang / lag g.yon gong bzhin g.yon nas bskor te dpung g.yas steng du thod khrag yab kyi zhal du stobs pa'i tshul dang / g.yas kyi rting skor dang bstun che bzhi la g.yon gsig byas la 'gying zhing grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ skyod 'gros skor gcig go /'gying chen nas 'di'i bar gyi 'cham tshul 'di cung sku khams nyog pas gzhi pad ces pa rnams la pad skor re re gnang zhing rol mo rnams myur tsam mdzad/ de dag gis gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa'o/ /sras mchog khro bo rigs lnga bskyed pa ni 'cham tshul tshang ma gtso bo yab dang 'dra bas de'i khongs su bsdus nas phyag len la mi mdzad/ khro bo bcu'i stangs stabs ni dkyil 'khor gang 'bri ba'i dbus su cho ga dang bstun nas mdzad de/ khro mo bcu'i gshon 'cham yang de'i khongs rgyal du 'du'o// ༈ /phyag brnyan bcu'i brjid 'cham gyi dang po dang gnyis pa ni/ steng dang shar gyi phyag brnyan ni/ /rdo rje dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /zhes brjod/ rnga skad che ba gsum la gong bzhin rol pa/ de nas rnga skad che ba bzhi dang chung ba gcig ste lnga rdeg tu bsgyur te pad skor rnams la gong bzhin rnga skad chung ba bya ste gzhi pad tshar nas lag g.yas dpung pa g.yas steng du rdo rje 'dzin tshul gyis mtho bar phyar/ g.yon sdigs mdzub lta bu'i ban+dha snying khar bzung nas rnga skad chung ba lnga la phyag rgya'i bca' gzhi tsam gyis lus cung zad 'gul zhing 'cham/ yang de bas rnga skad cung zad che ba lnga la lus rgyab mdun du gcu zhing gsig yod tsam gyis 'phyong grab dang / che ba bzhi la kha mdun bltas de ga'i ngang nas g.yas phyogs 'phyong zhing 'phar la rkang gnyis shud 'gros kyis 'gro/

rnga skad chung ba gcig la lus g.yas su nem zhing 'gyings/ don rnga skad che ba bzhi dang chung ba gcig ste lnga'o/ /yang chung ba lnga la lag g.yon gong bzhin g.yas mdun du brkyangs/ khu tshur kha gyen bstan las mdzub mo lcags kyu'i tshul du bya/ rkang g.yas rgyab phyogs la bskor zhing kha phyir bstan/ rnga che ba bzhi la g.yas 'gro phyogs su 'phyong zhing chung ba gcig la 'gying ba/ rkang gnyis shud 'gros sogs gong bzhin/ de nas chung lnga la g.yas dang / yang chung lnga la g.yon gyis bya ba sogs grol bsdu gong bzhin no/ /rnga skad de ga'i 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros gcig rdeg skor gcig go /gsum pa dang / bzhi pa ni/ me dang lho'i phyag brnyan ni/ /dbyug to dang ni dbyug pa 'dzin/ /zhes brjod la/ 'di man gyi rol pa nas 'gros kyi bar gong dang lag stabs ma gtogs khyad par cung zad med par shes par bya'o/ /kha nang bstan gyi lag stabs ni/ lag g.yas mdun du brkyangs te dbyug to 'dzin tshul dang / g.yon brla g.yon steng brkyang / kha phyir bstan gyi lag stabs ni/ lag g.yas dpung steng g.yas su dbyug pa 'dzin tshul gyis mtho bar brgyang / g.yon gong bzhin// ༈ /lnga pa dang / drug pa ni/ bden bral nub kyi phyag brnyan ni/ /ral gri dang ni pad+ma 'dzin/ /zhes brjod la 'cham tshul gong bzhin las lag stabs dang po ni/ g.yas kyi mthe'u chung dang srin mdzub mthe bong gis mnan/ gung mdzub gnyis ral gri'i tshul du brkyangs te/ mdun g.yon zur nas lag g.yon 'og nas g.yas zur bar gcod pa'i tshul dang / g.yon snying gar cung zad brgyang / lag stabs gnyis pa g.yas dpung g.yas steng thal mo kha gyen bstan du pad+ma 'dzin tshul gyis cung dma' bar bya/ g.yon gong bzhin no/ /bdun pa dang brgyad pa ni/ /rlung dang byang gi phyag brnyan ni/ /rdo rje dang ni rgya gram 'dzin/ /zhes brjod la 'cham tshul rnams gong bzhin las/ lag stabs dang po ni/

lag gnyis dpung pa g.yon steng sor mo bsnol la thal mo sbyar/ gnyis pa g.yon de nyid las lag g.yas phral te mdzub mo brkyangs nas mdun phyogs su rgya gram 'bri tshul bya ba'o/ /dgu pa dang bcu pa ni/ dbang ldan 'og gi phyag brnyan ni/ /rdo rje dang ni tho ba 'dzin/ /zhes brjod la 'cham tshul 'gros ma gtogs gong bzhin te/ lag stabs dang po ni/ lag gnyis dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du brkyangs la g.yas rdo rje 'dzin tshul bya/ gnyis pa g.yon de nyid las lag g.yas g.yon pa'i phrag gong bzhag la tho ba 'gel tshul byed pa'o/ /'gros ni skyod 'gros gcig rdeg ste phyag brnyan bcu'o/ /phra men bcu'i gshon 'cham ni 'cham tshul thams cad gong dang 'dra ba las/ rnga che ba gsum dang chung ba gcig ste bzhi rdeg dang / lag stabs mi 'dra ba tsam mo/ /de la dang po dang gnyis pa ni/ steng dang shar gyi phra men ni/ /dril bu dang ni rnga g.yab 'dzin/ /zhes brjod/ lag stabs dang po ni/ lag gnyis dpung pa gnyis kyi steng du kha thur bstan 'byar la khad du dril bu 'dzin tshul lo /gnyis pa ni/ g.yon de nyid las g.yas mdun du rnga yab g.yob tshul lo/ /gsum pa dang bzhi pa ni/ me dang lho'i phra men ni/ /me dbal dang ni dgra sta 'dzin/ /zhes brjod la/ lag stabs dang po ni/ g.yas khu tshur dpung pa g.yas pa'i steng du cung zad brgyangs pa me thab 'dzin tshul dang / g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub bya/ gnyis pa g.yon de nyid las lag g.yas kyi sor mo bzhi sgrengs/ mdun du dgra sta 'debs tshul byed pa'o/ /lnga pa dang drug pa ni/ bden bral nub kyi phra men ni/ /zhags pa dang ni sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /zhes brjod/ lag stabs dang po ni/ lag gnyis mdun du lag mgo gnyis rgyab sprod du bsnol nas brkyangs te zhags mig gi tshul du bya/ gnyis pa g.yon de nyid las g.yas phral nas mdun du sbrul zhags 'khyug pa'i tshul bya ba'o/ /bdun pa dang brgyad pa ni/

/rlung dang byang gi phra men ni/ /'khor lo dang ni be con 'dzin/ /zhes brjod/ lag stabs dang po ni/ g.yon pa thugs kar ban+dha kha gyen bstan du bzung / g.yas pa'i gru mo de nang du bcug g.yas khu tshur las mdzub mo brkyangs te 'khor lo skor tshul du bya/ gnyis pa ni/ de nyid las g.yas kyi mdzub mo bskums mkhrig ma nang du gug pa be con 'dzin tshul du byed ba'o/ /dgu pa dang bcu pa ni/ dbang ldan 'og gi phra men ni/ /rtse gsum dang ni gtun shing 'dzin/ /zhes brjod/ lag stabs dang po ni/ g.yas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo gzhan gsum lcags kyu ltar gug pa dpung pa g.yas steng mtho bar phyar zhing lag g.yon brla steng g.yon par brkyang / gnyis pa lag g.yon de nyid las g.yas pa gsang gnas kyi thad ma reg tsam du gru mo cung zad gug cing / lag mgo kha phyir bstan gyis gtun shing 'dzin tshul bya zhing / gong bzhin skyod 'gros byed pa ste phra men bcu'o/ /sgo ma bzhi'i rngam 'cham ste/ dang po shar sgo'i gnod sbyin mo ni/ gnod sbyin dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin/ /zhes brjod cing / slob dpon zhal shar phyogs dang / gzhan rnams rang rang gang bsdad sar kha phyir bltas la rnga che ba gsum la rol pa gong bzhin bya/ de nas rnga skad rdo rje ltar bzhi rdeg tu bsgyur la bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis gnyis la pad skor rdzogs pa'i 'phyong pad dang / bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis la lag g.yon ban+dha nu ma gnyis kyi thad tsam du kha gyen bstan du bzung / g.yas kyi gru mo ban nang du bcug khu tshur kha phyir bstan gyis mdzub mo lcags kyu ltar gug pa dang dzam bya zhing lus cung zad rgyab mdun du gcu zhing dzam bca' gzhi tsam gyi ngos/ /bzhi rdeg chung ba rting ma'i gsum dang bzhi cung che bar byas la/ lus rgyab mdun gcu zhing 'phyong tshul dang / rol mo che ba gnyis dang bzhi rdeg gcig gi dang po che ba gcig ste gsum la rkang pa rbad 'phyong kha phyir bstan gyi gsum dang /

bzhi rdung de'i gnyis gsum bzhi rnams la rkang g.yon btegs/ g.yon phyogs su bskor zhing kha nang la cung zad bltas la rkang g.yon btegs pa de ga'i ngang nas sngar shul du log ste mdun phyogs su bzhag yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas kyi phyogs bskor zhing kha nang la blta/ rkang g.yas nang du phab/ yang chung bzhi la rkang g.yon btegs/ g.yon phyogs bskor zhing kha nang la blta/ rkang g.yon nang du phab/ yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gcig la rkang g.yas bskor zhing nang du phab pa sogs gong bzhin las/ gsum dang bzhi cung che zhing lus g.yas la gcu 'phyong tshul che ba'i ngos/ shar du rbad 'phyong gsum byed pa sogs gong bzhin bskyar nas lan gnyis te thengs gsum gyis rting ma'i kha g.yas bsgyur g.yon bsgyur g.yas bsgyur gsum song ba'i g.yas kyi rting ma rdzogs mtshams 'phyong tshul mi bya ba bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis gnyis la gong bzhin g.yas g.yon gyis grol bsdu byas la/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes/ ldem 'gros bzhi rdeg skor gcig go /gnyis pa lho sgo'i 'jigs byed mo ni/ 'jigs byed ser mo zhags pa 'dzin/ /zhes brjod la kha lho phyogs phyir blta/ bzhi rdeg gnyis la rol pa dang / 'phyong pad nas 'gros kyi bar 'cham tshul tshang ma phal cher gong dang 'dra/ khyad par lag stabs lcags kyu'i tshab lag gnyis dpung steng mtho bar brkyangs la zhags pa 'dzin tshul lo/ /grol bsdu nas ldem 'gros bar 'dra/ gsum pa nub sgo'i bdud rtsi mo ni/ bdud rtsi dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin/ /zhes brjod/ kha nub phyogs phyir blta/ gzhan 'gros kyi bar gong dang 'dra/ lag stabs ni g.yas dpung g.yas steng du phyar zhing / g.yon dpung g.yon steng sbyar la zhags pa'i tshab lcags sgrog mtho dma'i 'dzin tshul lo/ /grol bsdu nas ldem 'gros bar 'dra/ bzhi pa gsod byed ma ni/ gsod byed ljang gu dril bu 'khrol/ /zhes brjod/ kha byang phyogs phyir blta/

rol pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba las/ lag stabs ni lag mgo gnyis dpung steng gnyis su 'byar la khad kyis lcags sgrog tshab dril bu 'dzin tshul ngos 'phyong ba dang / rdzogs nas grol bsdu/ 'phyong pad/ 'phyong rjes gong dang 'dra zhing / 'gros skyod 'gros skor gcig go /de dag gis ni rtsa ba'i lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi gar 'cham rdzogs so// ༈ /de nas dam can gyi 'cham ni/ dam can spyi'i bskul 'cham/ zhes brjod/ rnga 'theng rdung du bsgyur la 'phyong pad byas shing / lag gnyis rol pa ltar brgyangs te g.yas g.yon re mos kyis rkang pa dang bstun mtho dma' bya zhing / 'theng rkang che myur la 'phyong zhing skor ba gcig byas la 'khor mtshams su rnga skad je chung je chung la btang zhing 'cham skad dang bstun rol mo bzhag de nas dbang phyug ma las bzhi'i 'dur 'cham ni/ shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /khyod kyis zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /zhes brjod/ gong bzhin 'phyong pad rdzogs mtshams lag gnyis g.yas zur du mnan/ lus g.yas rgyab phyogs su gcu zhing sgyid ldem che bar gsig lag g.yon sked gzer dang / lag g.yas rgyab mdun du g.yob cing phyar/ rkang g.yon btegs la mdun nas bskor te g.yas zur du sleb mtshams sngar shul du log ste 'gro phyogs bzhag rkang g.yas btegs shing 'gro phyogs bzhag pa sogs g.yas g.yon re mos kyis 'phyong zhing 'theng rkang drag myur ngos/ gral gyi phreng ba bar thag ma chad cing 'grig pa skor ba gcig tsam bya zhing / rol mo chung du gtong ba sogs gong dang 'dra/ de mtshams lho nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ khyod kyis rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /ces brjod/ 'phyong pad go bslogs te dbus/ g.yas/ dbus/ g.yon rdzogs pa dang / lus g.yon rgyab tu gcu ba/ lag gnyis gnon pa sogs 'dra/ rkang g.yas btegs/ mdun bskor te g.yon zur du sleb pa dang / sngar shul du log ste g.yas zur du phab/

rkang g.yon gong bzhin mdun nas bskor zhing 'gro phyogs phab/ lag g.yas sked gzer dang / g.yon gong gi g.yas bzhin g.yob cing 'phyong rgyug gi skor ba gcig tsam bya/ rol mo chung du gtong ba sogs 'dra/ nub nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /khyod kyis dbang gi las mdzod cig /zhes brjod la 'cham tshul shar dang 'dra/ byang nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor bdun/ /khyod kyis drag po'i las mdzod cig /zhes brjod la 'cham tshul lho dang 'dra/ de nas rol mo chung du song mtshams/ phra men ma baṃ len gyi 'cham/ zhes brjod/ de la bzhi ste dang po/ bam btsal ba ni/ rol pa dang sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros kyis btsal ba'o/ /dang po rol pa ni/ dam can spyi 'cham dang 'dra ba/ gnyis pa sbrul nag 'khyog 'gros ni/ 'cham tshul shar nas gshegs pa'i rnal 'byor dang 'dra la/ bskor ba bya tshul ni/ sbrul nag 'khyil ba phyir gshigs nas 'khyog 'gros kyi 'gro ba ltar 'cham dpon gyis sna drangs/ 'cham sna ba de rjes mthud nas gral gyi phreng ba ma zhig pa 'khyog 'gros su 'gro ba'i 'khyog mtshams rnams su mi'am rtags gang rung re byas la 'cham pa tshang mas rtags rgyang bskyur ma byas par/ 'cham dpon gang phebs kyi rjes su 'gro/ mthar 'cham dpon dkyil dang / gzhan rnams kha do ra'i nang la bltas te 'khor mtshams/ 'theng rkang drag myur de las cung chung ba'i 'theng rkang gsum bzhi tsam gyi bar la ban+dha kha phub tu 'jog tshul gyis dzam bya zhing lag g.yas gang bder bzhag dpon slob tshang ma mig blta bsgrigs te thams cad mthun pa dang ban skra bsnar te rang rang gi mdun du kha phub tu bzhag la 'cham dpon dkyil dang / gzhan rnams do ra tshang ma la dam can spyi 'cham ji lta ba bzhin bskor la rang rang gi ban+dha'i sar sleb par bya'o/ /don gnyis pa baṃ brtag pa la gsum gyi dang po dris brtag pa ni/ 'theng rkang de ga'i ngang nas g.yon zur ban+dha la bstan pa'i 'phyong pad byas rjes lag g.yon sked gzer dang /

lag g.yas g.yas nas g.yab cing pus mo la bskor ba'i tshul 'theng rkang che ba gsum la rkang g.yas rim pas spos shing g.yas zur ban+dha la bstan/ 'theng rkang chung ba gsum la lag g.yas kyi mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ sor mo gzhan gsum brkyang la ban+dha bam ling gar bsam la shi ma shi dri brtag pa'i phyir lus sgur zhing sor mo'i rtse mo ban+dha la reg sna rtser sor mo reg la dri bsnams te ma shi ba 'dra snyam pa'i dred sngangs kyis 'theng rkang che ba gcig la lus 'phar zhing g.yon zur phyir 'phyong la lag g.yon kha'i thad kar phyir bstan dang / lce gnyis ka cung zad bskyod de kha rog 'dug ces pa'i brda bya/ yang pad skor dang / 'theng rkang che ba gsum la lag g.yas sked gzer dang / g.yon pa g.yon nas pus mo la bskor ba/ g.yon zur ban+dha la bstan nas dri brtag pa/ dred tshul gyis g.yas zur phyir bstan gyis phyir 'phyong ba/ lag g.yas dang lce bskyod tshul sogs 'cham tshul gong dang 'dra'o/ /gnyis pa rde'us brtag pa ni/ pad skor gcig byas la 'theng rkang che ba bzhi la lag gnyis brgyangs te g.yas g.yon re mos kyis tshul du mtho dma' bya zhing / g.yon ban+dha la bstan la g.yas kyis rde'u rnyed na dang / ma rnyed na phur pa'i rtse ban+dha phyogs la bstan nas bzung / lag gnyis cung zad mdun la brkyangs shing lus sgur la 'theng rkang chung gsum rdzogs pa dang / lag g.yon gyis ban+dha la 'gre ldog bya zhing g.yas pas rde'u'am phur rtse ban+dha la thag sgra thon pa brgyabs nas ma shi bar nges shes 'drongs te snying rjes kun nas bslangs/ gnas skabs bsgral dgos snyam pa'i zhe sdang drag po'i tshul gyis lus 'dar zhing gnam du 'phar la lag g.yas g.yas kyi rgyab zur phyogs bskor kha phyir bstan nas/ lag gnyis brgyangs pa mtho dma'i tshul gyis rang rang gi ban+dha la dam can spyi 'cham bzhin bskor grub mtshams ban+dha so so la kha phyogs pa'o/

/gsum pa slar yang nges pa bskyed pa'i phyir pho rog rdo rje 'gros kyis brtag pa ni/ rnga bzhi rdeg tu bsgyur la/ lus sgur zhing lag gnyis mtheb mdzub sbyar bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis la pus mo g.yon steng nas mdun la bskor zhing g.yon zur du sleb pa'i dzam gnyis lus cung zad gsig cing bya/ bzhi rdeg rting ma'i gsum dang bzhi cung che ba dang bstun sgyid ldem ngos lus ldem zhing lag gnyis phod gsham sdud pa'i tshul gyis pus mo gnyis la bkab nas/ slar dred nas 'gros tshul gyis g.yas phyogs rnga skad che ba gnyis dang bzhi rdeg gcig gis dang po che ba ste gsum la shod 'gros kyis 'phyong la/ bzhi rdeg gi gnyis gsum bzhi rnams la g.yas phyogs 'gying zhing nem/ yang bzhi rdeg chung ba gnyis la gong bzhin pus steng dzam byas nas g.yon phyogs sngar shul log cing g.yon zur baṃ la bstan te g.yon phyogs 'gyings/ yang dzam byas la dred tshul gyis rgyab la gong bzhin 'phyong nas g.yas phyogs 'gying ba 'dra/ de nas dzam gong bzhin byas la zhe sdang langs te gsod pa'i bsam pas mdun du rngam zhing gong bzhin 'phyong gsum gyis gsum pa la ban+dha baṃ gyi tsar dkyil mo dkrung gi blo lhod kyis glod la bsdad pa'o/ /don gsum pa la gsum gyi dang po mgron spyan drang ba ni/ rnga skad chung ba lnga la pad skor byas la/ che ba lnga la g.yas zur mdun gyi nam mkha' la blta zhing lag gnyis brkyangs la g.yob pa'i tshul byed cing mthar smin mtshams 'og tsam du lag gnyis lhod de bzhag zhi gnyis zhi ba'i lha tshogs byon par bsam/ yang gong bzhin chung ba lnga la pad skor dang / che lnga la g.yon zur gyis nam mkha' la blta zhing lag gnyis brkyangs la g.yob pa'i tshul bya zhing mthar smin mtshams 'og tsam du lag gnyis gong ltar lhod de bzhag la/ lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khro bo'i lha tshogs byon par bsam/ yang gong bzhin pad skor dang g.yas rgyab phyogs nas lag gnyis g.yab cing dpung pa g.yas steng gong ltar bzhag ste chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs byon par bsam/

yang chung lnga la pad skor dang che lnga la lag gnyis g.yon gyi rgyab phyogs nas g.yab cing dpung pa g.yon steng gong ltar bzhag phur srung dam can 'khor bcas byon par bsam/ yang chung lnga la pad skor dang che lnga la lag gnyis dbus kyi nam mkhar g.yab cing smin mtshams kyi 'og thad tsam gong ltar bzhag cing rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin rig pa'i brgyud pa/ gdams ngag snyan gong gi brgyud pa rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar te/ bla ma brgyud pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon zhing / rang rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa baṃ bsgral zhing bsha' ba'i tshul ni/ gong bzhin chung lnga la pad skor dang / che lnga la phur rtse g.yas su sa la brdar/ yang chung lnga la pad skor dang che lnga la phur rtse g.yon du sa la brdar/ yang chung ba lnga la pad skor dang / che ba lnga la phur pa g.yas su bsgril/ yang chung lnga la pad skor dang / che lnga la phur pa g.yon du bsgril/ yang chung lnga la pad skor dang che lnga la phur pa dbus su bsgril zhing rol mo chem rdung dang bcas pas liṅga sgrol ba'i sngags 'don bzhin pas dgra bgegs kyi snying gar btab par bsam la ban+dha'i dbus su phur rtse btsugs/ dgongs pa rnam gsum dran pa'i sgo nas/ rnam shes a dkar po'i rnam par phur rtse la bsdus te 'og min du rigs lnga yab yum gyi sbyor mtshams su bskyal bar bsam la phur rtse nam mkha' la bstan nas phaṭa ces brjod/ bam bsha' ba ni/ yang chung lnga la pad skor dang / che lnga la phur rtses ban+dha'i skra sum cha g.yas phyogs su 'then/ yang chung lnga la pad skor dang / che lnga la phur rtses ban+dha'i skra sum cha g.yon zur du 'then/ yang chung lnga la pad skor dang / che lnga la phur rtses ban+dha'i skra sum cha dbus nas phyir thad kar 'then pa ste bsha' ba'i tshul lo/ /gsum pa ling ro byin gyis brlab pa/ phud bla ma yi dam la dbul ba/ lhag rang nyid sogs longs spyod tshul dang gsum las/

dang po 'dod yon lngar byin gyis brlab pa ni/ chung lnga la pad skor dang che lnga la ban+dha'i steng du lag gnyis sor mo rnams rtse sprad pa rū pa'i phyag rgya bca' zhing g.yas g.yon du bskyod pa ste gzugs dang / yang chung lnga la pad skor/ che lnga la lag gnyis pi wang bsgyur tshul te sgra dang / yang chung lnga la pad skor che lnga la lag gnyis kha phyir bstan du sor mo rnams bsgrengs te baṃ la bstan la g.yas g.yon du bskyod tshul byed pa dri'o/ /yang chung lnga la pad skor/ che lnga la lag gnyis sor mo kha gyen bstan du bsnol/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i phyag rgya bskyod pa ro dang / yang chung lnga la pad skor che lnga la lag gnyis kyis phur dar gyi sne nas gos gzungs 'bul ba ltar brgyangs shing mthar ban+dha la bkab pa reg bya ste/ kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs par bsam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ling ro byin gyis brlabs pa de bla ma yi dam la 'bul tshul ni/ yang chung lnga la pad skor che lnga la lag gnyis kyis thod pa'i bdud rtsi de nas gcus la bla ma brgyud pa la 'bul bar bsam ste/ lag gnyis kha gyen bstan dbus kyi nam mkha' la mtho bar btegs la 'bul tshul bya/ de bzhin du mdun gyi g.yas zur gyi nam mkhar zhi ba'i lha tshogs/ g.yon zur du khro bo'i lha mo/ rgyab kyi g.yas zur du chos skyong srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs/ rgyab kyi g.yon zur du phur srung dam can gyi lha tshogs te gnas de dag tu pad skor dang 'bul tshul/ dmigs pa sogs gong gi dbus bzhin bya ba'o/ /gsum pa lhag rang nyid sogs longs spyod tshul ni/ chung lnga la pad skor dang che lnga la lag gnyis kyis bdud rtsi blangs te rang gi rdo rje spun grogs mched lcam g.yas phyogs pa rnams la 'bul tshul bya/ yang chung lnga la pad skor che lnga la gong bzhin bdud rtsi blangs te mched lcam g.yon phyogs pa rnams la 'bul tshul bya/

yang chung lnga la pad skor che lnga la bdud rtsi blangs te rang gi zhal du stobs tshul byas za ba'i stangs ka bye/ yang chung lnga la pad skor dang che lnga la 'khyos ma 'khur tshul gyis rang gi am phrag tu 'jug tshul dang / yang chung lnga la pad skor che lnga la 'thu ba g.yas par 'thum pa'i tshul bya/ yang chung lnga la pad skor che lnga la 'thu ba g.yon par 'thum pa'i tshul bya ba'o/ /don bzhi pa so so skye bo'i blo snang la skra dang / keng rus dang / sha dang / lpags pa la sogs pa'i lhag ma cung zad yod snyam pa 'byung bas/ de nyid khur zhing bskyur nas bzlog pa bya bar bsam pa'i tshul ni/ rol mo chem rdung shin tu chung ba gcig dang bstun lag g.yas phur rtse sa la btsugs/ g.yon gyis ban skra nas cung zad 'then la 'khur ba'i grab kyis lang ba la ma theg pa'i tshul gyis 'dar zhing g.yas phyogs su 'gyel/ yang phur pa btsugs nas rol mo sogs gong bzhin byas la lus bsrangs te 'dar zhing g.yon phyogs 'gyel/ de nas hod langs brgyabs ban+dha phrag g.yon bkal/g.yas phur dar rgyab mdun dkrugs shing thams cad byi'u khyu la rdo phog pa bzhin 'thor zhing rgyug rol mo chem rdung che ba drag myur dang bstun la mthar lung pa'i mda' phyogs la thams cad 'phur te ling ro lhag ma rnams bskyur zhing phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad dgra phyogs su bzlog par bsam la ban+dha 'phyang phrul ngos lag gnyis kyis phur pa bsgril/ kī la ya drag tu 'don pa'o/ /de nas thams cad do rar phebs pa dang / dpon slob rnams phyed bgod bya/ rol mo ba rnams kyis mdun gyi g.yas g.yon du zhal sprod tshul gyis/ gong du dpal chen po la phud phul ba'i lhag ma 'cham rar khyer ba de gtang rag gi tshul du bstan ma bcu gnyis la 'bul tshul ni/ rnga rdung ba sogs dpon slob tshang mas lag gnyis rgyab sprod kyis mthe'u chung gnyis bsnol/ mthe bong gnyis lag mthil du bkug

sor mo lhag ma rnams khyung gi gshog pa ltar brkyangs pa/ khyung gshog gis zil gyis gnon pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ ho bod khams skyong bar byed pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis zhes pa nas/ e a ra li hring hring zhes pa'i bar brjod/ de nas rol mo bcam zhing 'cham pa rnams g.yon zur nang du bstan/ lag gnyis g.yon gyi brla steng brkyang / chung ba ji ltar rigs pa la dzam bya zhing / rnga bzhi rdeg che ba dang / lag g.yas g.yas kyi rgyab zur du rkang g.yas sa la 'jog pa dang bstun phur dar ngom phyir nam mkhar dkrugs shing phyar la g.yas su gzhol nas brkyangs/ de mthun rkang g.yon mdun gyi g.yon zur du btegs/ lag g.yon nam mkhar phyar zhing pad bskor ltar bskor/ yang bzhi rdeg gcig la rkang g.yon/ lag g.yon phab/ rkang g.yas rkang g.yon mdun du bzhag cing phur rtse ban nang du bcug yang bzhi rdeg gcig la rkang stabs lag stabs gong dang 'dra bar bya/ dgu rdeg gcig la lag gnyis sked gzer byas/ mgo med mjug med kyis gang byung rgyug pa ma yin pa rkang g.yon btegs pa phab 'phral g.yas nas brtsams te nyis dgrongs bya/ bdun dang brgyad la rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs kyi mdun du phab/ dgu pa la rkang g.yas rgyab nas bskor zhing do ra'i nang du g.yas zur bstan cing phab/ yang bzhi rdeg gsum la gong bzhin pad skor gyi tshul du byas la rdzogs pa dang / bh+yoḥbaka' yi bran g.yog tshig gnyis la dbyangs dang bstun lag gnyis mdun du ban gsig cung zad bya zhing dbyangs skad 'degs che ba'i dus su lag gnyis gsig cing sgyid ldem cung che ba bya/ dbyangs rdzogs pa dang gong bzhin dgu rdeg dang / gong 'og gi pad skor sogs 'cham tshul thams cad 'dra/ yang tshur gshegs sogs tshig gnyis kyi ring la dbyangs sogs dang / rdzogs mtshams dgu rdeg gi sne bsnol du 'gro ba sogs thams cad gong dang 'dra ba'o/ /'di'i dgu rdeg la grangs mi 'dzin par rtsed 'jos rgyug pa dang /

blo la bde dogs gang yang med par phyin te dgu zhes pa bsgrig pa kho na byed pa ni gar 'cham ma yin/ dig pa'i brtol spyod 'ba' zhig yin pas spang bar bya'o/ /blo skyon med pa'i brgyug dgos pa ni thog ma nas 'chug pa'i skyon yin pas/ gral bsgrigs pa'i dus zhal sprod kyi phrag la 'dom do las lhag pa ma byung ba byas na 'cham tshul shin tu 'grig cing legs pa yong ngo / /dbyangs gnyis pa'i 'cham rdzogs mtshams 'dir gshegs dam dgongs nas dal bus bshang la rnga skad dang bstun 'cham pa rnams lag gnyis 'cham pa'i tshul gyis ban gsig cung zad bya/ de nas bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ zhes pa'i bar brjod tshar ba dang 'cham pa rnams lag g.yon sked gzer/ lag g.yas mdun rgyab tu g.yug cing / dpon slob tshang ma phyir gshegs nas do ra la bskor/ rnga rdung ba dang bcas thams cad kyis/ hūm̐ dam tshig 'di las ma 'da' zhig /zhes gdangs dang bstun lag g.yas mdun du g.yug dus/ rkang g.yas btegs la mdun nas bskor te g.yon zur 'gro phyogs su bzhag cing sked ldem che bar bya/ yang rgyab la g.yug dus rkang g.yon rgyab nas bskor zhing 'gro phyogs su bzhag sked ldem gong dang 'dra bas 'cham tshul de bzhin/ de bas bdag gis bcol ba yi/ /zhes pa'i bar byas nas/ thams cad do ra nang la zhal gzigs te/ phrin las thams cad 'grub par mdzod/ /zhes pa'i bar ban phur mdun du rol dbyangs 'cham pa'i tshul gyis cung zad gsig cing / 'grub par gyis bar gyi dzar rgyag dus lag gnyis pad skor lta bu gong gi bzhi rdeg dang 'dra bar bya/ de nas rdzogs mtshams bzhi rdeg gsum la pad skor gyi tshul gong bzhin la dbyangs kyi dus bzhi rdeg dang po dbyangs mjug gi tshig lhad rol mo dang bstun pa yin/ dgu rdeg la lag gnyis rol stabs kyis g.yas nas mdun la bskor la bdun brgyad ces pa'i dus g.yon mdun la bskor zhing lag g.yas g.yon pa'i gru mo'i 'og tsam du sleb pa dang /

dgu la lag mgo gnyis g.yon phyogs mnyam nas cung zad brkyangs shing lus nem gsig dang / rnga che ba gcig la mnan/ yang bzhi rdeg gsum la gong bzhin pad skor lta bu gsum bya la chem rdung dang / mchod g.yog pas phud chang dang bstun gtor ma phyogs mtshams gang rigs la gtor zhing phul/ dpon slob rnams kyis legs pa'i phrin bcol mdzad/ de nas rol mo de ga'i ngang nas dpon slob thams cad phyogs gcig tu 'dus la 'cham khang sogs gang 'byon sa la zhal phyogs par bzhugs te/ dar pa/ dung pa/ rgya gling pa sogs lag khyer ba rnams rim pas sngon la 'gro phyogs bsgrig de'i mdun na phar 'cham sna bas sna drangs te rnga bzhi rdeg chung ba gsum tsam gyi ring la g.yon 'gro phyogs su bstan lag gnyis kyis 'cham zhing / de nas bzhi rdeg che ba dang bstun rdo rje phyed 'gros ltar ra 'bri tshul dang / sked gzer bar 'dra ba la 'phyong ba'i tshe lag gnyis dang rkang pa bstun te g.yas g.yon re mos kyis g.yab cing 'phyong ba ste rtse gsum mam me ri 'gros zhes bya'o/ /tshul des dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'am/ yang thag ring na gang 'tshams pa'i bar bya'o/ /de nas dpon slob rnams dkyil 'khor khang par byon/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor bri sa'i dbus dang / gzhan rnams de'i mtha' la bskor te khro bcu rol pa'i stangs stabs bya tshul ni rnga rdung ba rnams lag gnyis thal mo sbyar zhing dbyangs sogs cho ga mdzad pa tsam ma gtogs 'cham sogs mi dgos/ 'cham pa dpon slob tshang ma ban phur thogs shing 'cham tshul ni dbyangs dang bstun nas bya ste// ༈ /o 'au oṃ zhes pa'i dus bca' gzhi tsam las/ hūm̐ nga'i zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas btegs/ lag gnyis dpung steng gnyis su brgyangs la/ chen ne'i zhes pa'i skabs su lag stabs de ga'i ngang nas rkang g.yas mdun du phab cing lus cung zad nem/ de nas sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrangs la/ ka ba'i zhes pa'i dus su rkang g.yas de ga'i ngang nas ma btegs pa sa la bskor/
