rkang g.yon gyi rtse mo rgyab nas drud cing / zhal thams cad kyi rgyab phyogs phyir gzigs/ ra'i 'e 'e yi zhes pa'i dus rkang pa gnyis thad sor bzhag lag gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi thad tsam 'jog 'a'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus lus nem che ba dang sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrang zhing / phyag ga'i zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yas btegs/ lag gnyis gong bzhin brgyangs la/ rgya 'a 'a ba zhes pa'i skabs rkang stabs gong bzhin g.yas phyogs mdun ngos su bskor la/ zhal thams cad kyi mdun phyogs gzigs/ ni 'e 'e ya zhes pa'i skabs rkang pa gnyis thad sor bzhag lag gnyis pus mo gnyis kyi thad tsam 'jog 'a'i ya'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus cung zad lus nem zhing sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrang / lag ga'i dus phur pa ban+dha la bskor/ gnyis ya'i dus phur pa nam mkha' la phyar/ thal 'a la'i zhes pa'i dus phur rtse ban nang du bcug lus cung zad nem zhing sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrang ba ste yangs pa'i pad skor dbus dang / sbyar 'a 'a ra zhes pa'i dus g.yon phyogs su phur pa ban+dha la bskor/ 'a'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus phur pa nam mkha' la phyar/ phyag ga'i dus phur rtse ban nang du bcug lus cung zad nem zhing sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrang ba g.yon gyi pad skor dang / gyen na'i dus yang g.yas phyogs su phur pa ban+dha la bskor/ du 'u 'u 'u zhes pa'i dus phur pa nam mkhar phyar/ bsgreng 'a 'a nga zhes pa'i dus phur rtse ban nang du bcug pa g.yas kyi pad skor te pad skor gsum mo/ /'a'i ya'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus lus cung zad nem zhing gsig rkang nga'i gnyis ya 'a 'a'i/ mthil 'e 'e le 'e 'e sbyar 'a 'a ra/ 'a'i ya'i thur ru du 'u 'u 'u zug 'u 'u ya zhes pa'i bar la lag gnyis thal mo sbyar te dpral ba'i thad du gyen du bsgrengs/ rkang gnyis kyi mthil sa la sbyar nas rting pa gnyis sprad pa'i bar la sor bzhi lhag pa sogs gang thub byas nas gel pa'i 'dug stangs kyis pus mo gnyis phyir bkyed la lus cung zad nem zhing sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrang /

'a'i ya'i ya'i dus lag stabs de ga las lus g.yon mdun du gcus shing gsig gnyis bya zhing g.yon 'gying che bar mnan la/ tshigs ge chen ne 'e 'e zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon rting skor dang g.yas gsig tshig re dang bstun gnyis byas la g.yas su 'gying zhing lus nem la yang sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrangs te/ bzhi 'e 'e yo'i yang 'a 'a nga zhes pa'i dus lus dbus su thad kar blta zhing / lag gnyis de ga'i ngang nas rkang gnyis gel ba'i tshul gyis nem/ yang sgyid pa hod 'degs kyis bsrangs la 'a'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus g.yon gong bzhin mdun du gcu zhing 'gyings/ bcag ga par ra 'a 'a zhes pa'i dus gong bzhin g.yas gsig gnyis dang 'gying ba 'dra/ bya 'a 'a ya zhes pa'i dus lus thad kar bsrang / oṃ mo badz+ra zhes pa'i dus dbus dang / kro 'o dha zhes pa'i dus g.yon dang / hūm̐ ngo ka ra zhes pa'i dus g.yas rnams su lag gnyis bskor zhing pad skor gyi tshul bya/ hūm̐ zhes pa'i dus g.yas zur rgyab tu gcus shing nem che ba dang / lag gnyis g.yas zur du brkyang / gardza gardza zhes pa'i dus g.yon sked gzer dang / rkang g.yas lag g.yas mdun nas bskor te bskor ba tshang ma gcig song ba dang / hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa'i dus lag g.yas ban+dha la bskor zhing g.yas phyogs su phur pa phyar/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub kyis ban+dha bzung / g.yas 'gying che bar byas/ rkang g.yon g.yon phyogs bgrad nas rting pa sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo gyen la btegs/ rkang g.yas khro bo'i bzhugs stangs ltar sgyid pa ldem zhing pus mo phyir bkyed la rkang mgo sa la thad kar bzhag pa'o/ /'di man la 'dur gdangs dang bstun/ rnam par rgyal ba'i phyag rgya ni/ /zhes pa'i dus bca' gzhi tsam bya/ lag gnyis thugs kar bsnol byas nas/ /zhes pa dang / tshig de dang mthun par thugs kar bsnol ba'i phyag rgya bcas nas tshig 'og ma gnyis ma rdzogs bar lus cung zad gsig cing / sngags brjod dus pad skor dang rkang g.yas nang la bskor zhing g.yas 'gying sogs gong bzhin phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams 'dra/

mtshams dang 'og gi khro bo la sngags brjod dus pad skor dbus/ g.yas g.yon du bya/ skor dus rkang g.yon nang la bskor/ lag g.yon phyar te g.yon 'gying bya gzhan 'dra/ stobs po che'i dbyangs kyi skabs lag rkang g.yas dang g.yon go brje g.yas skor g.yon skor du bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs/ 'cham tshul gong hūm̐ ka ra dang 'dra/ khro bo byin gyi phyag rgya tshig dang bstun nas rnam rgyal bzhin byed pas go sla'o/ /'on kyang rta mgrin gyi dus su lag gnyis spyi bor rgya bcings nas/ /zhes pa'i skabs su spyi bor mos la dpral ba'i thad lag gnyis rdo rje bsdams pa ltar byas la/ lus g.yas g.yon du gcu ba dang sgyid ldem bya/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skabs su sked pa brdung bar bstan pa ni/ /zhes pa'i dus lag gnyis sked gzer ngos sked pa g.yas skyog g.yon skyog byed/ stobs po che'i skabs su steng nas gnon pa lta bu bya/ /zhes pa'i tshe sor mo'i rtse rnams bsnol te dpral ba nas rim pas gnon tshul gyis lte ba'i bar phab la sgyid ldem bya zhing gsig pa tsam mo/ /de dag ni dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gsal byed rin po che'i do shal du/ steng dang phyogs kyi khro bo rnams/ /rkang g.yon drang bzhag g.yas nang bskor/ /'og dang mtshams kyi khro bo ni/ /g.yon pa nang du bskor bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don no/ /de nas bsrung ba la gnyis kyi dang po phur bu gdab pa ni/ cho ga dang dmigs pa zur 'debs bzhin yin la/ 'cham tshul la slob dpon shar du bltas pas/ lag g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang / g.yon hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa'i phur bu rnams rim pas bzung / gzhan rnams kyis g.yas ban+dha tho ba'i tshul dang / g.yon rang rang gi phur bu bzung la khro bo bcur mos/ steng phyogs tshangs pa bsnol ba'i dbyangs slob dpon gyis bying drangs dpon slob thams cad gsung 'grig cing snyan pa yid khul bar bya/ de nas kī la ya gsum gyi bar la rdo rje'i 'gros dbyangs dang bstun la bya ste/

de yang o 'o 'o oṃ/ zhes brjod dus lag pa g.yas lag g.yon la bskor nas dpung g.yas steng du phyar/ g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub bcas/ rkang g.yas rkang g.yon gyi thad nas bskor zhing g.yas thad du bzhag g.yon pa'i rting pa sa la btsugs/ rkang mgo btegs te g.yon zur du bgrad/ mo zhes pa'i skabs su rkang g.yon cung zad btegs la g.yas 'gying shin tu che ba g.yon zur 'gro phyogs bzhag lus cung zad gsig cing sgyid pa bsrang / bad da'i dz+ra zhes pa'i skabs su rkang g.yas btegs shing mdun nas bskor te g.yon gyi rgyab zur du rdo rje'i g.yas ra 'bri tshul dang / rkang g.yon g.yas pa'i rting pa'i rgyab tu rtse sa la ma reg tsam du btegs tsam bya/ lag pa g.yon gyi phur mgo g.yas rnams tho ba bzung bar bsam la phur mgo rdung tshul dang / ra'i dus sgyid pa bsrang / kī 'e 'e zhes pa'i skabs dang / li zhes pa'i dus rkang stabs lag stabs lus kyi rnam 'gyur rnams gong oṃ gyi dus dang khyad par med par bya/ kī la 'a 'a zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas g.yon gyi mdun zur du bzhag lag gnyis tho ba rdung tshul sogs gong bzhin gyi g.yas ra 'bri tshul byas nas lus nem zhing glo bur sgyid pa bsrang la/ ya 'a zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas rkang g.yon mdun nas bskor zhing g.yas zur du bzhag de bzhin lag gnyis cung zad btegs/ sked pa'i thad tsam du g.yas g.yon so sor bskor zhing sked gzer byas la rkang g.yon rting pa btsugs/ rkang mgo btegs lus nem dang g.yas 'gying che zhing rting skor ngos/ ro stod g.yas rgyab tu thog mar gcu de nas mdun dang / g.yon rgyab phyogs su gcus la sgeg pa'i tshul bya/ ba'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs shing lus cung zad gsig la g.yon zur bzhag sar ra ba 'a 'a zhes pa dus rkang g.yas g.yon zur gyi mdun la bskor zhing rdo rje'i lte ba 'bri tshul byas la g.yas zur phab/ de mthun lag gnyis ya 'a zhes pa'i dus dang 'dra bar byas la sked gzer dang /

big ge zhes pa'i dus lus nem zhing ro stod g.yas gcu g.yon gcu/ 'gying lus nem che ba sogs gong ya'i dus dang 'dra/ nan na'i zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs la de gar phab ste lus nem gsig sgyid pa glo bur bsrang / ban na'i zhes pa'i dus lag stabs rkang stabs gong gi oṃ dang 'dra/ dha 'a 'a zhes pa'i skabs su rkang g.yon cung zad btegs la g.yon zur 'gro phyogs bzhag lus cung zad gsig cing sgyid pa bsrang / hūm̐ gi skabs su rkang g.yas btegs shing 'gro phyogs bzhag lag g.yas tho ba dang ban+dhas g.yon gyi phur mgo rdung tshul bya zhing nga'i dus yang rkang g.yas btegs tsam byas nas phab la lus nem la cung zad gsig cing sgyid pa bsrang / phaṭa da'i ṭa zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs la 'gro phyogs bzhag lag stabs sogs 'dra/ de lta bu'i 'cham tshul lan gsum song rjes rnga rdung ba rnams kyis rnga phyi rdeg ngos chem rdung dang gha ta'i sngags brjod/ slob dpon gyis hūm̐ mdzad steng du 'debs tshul byas la shar lho'i g.yas sam shar gyi g.yas su phur gdan nam gang 'os su phyag len ltar btsugs/ rnam rgyal shar du 'debs tshul byas la shar ram shar lho'i dbus su gdab/ de bzhin du phyogs mtshams de dang der 'debs tshul gong ltar byas la/ dbyug sngon shar lho'am shar lho'i g.yon du gdab/ gshin rje lho'am lho nub kyi g.yas su gdab/ mi g.yo ba lho nub bam lho nub kyi g.yon du gdab/ rta mgrin nub bam nub byang gi g.yas su gdab/ gzhan gyi mi thub pa nub byang gi dbus sam g.yon du gdab/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba byang ngam byang shar gyi g.yas su gdab/ khams gsum rnam rgyal byang shar ram byang shar gyi g.yon du gdab/ stobs po che 'og tu 'debs tshul ngos nub byang gi g.yon du gdab pa'o/ /'dur gdangs rdzogs mtshams kyi rol mo dang 'cham tshul la/ thog ma'i 'theng rdung gsum gyi dang po la lus g.yas g.yon phyogs gcu zhing lag pa g.yas g.yon gyi sta zur mtshams su g.yobs/

lag g.yon g.yas kyi nu kha tsam du kha phub/ sgyid ldem che la lus dkrug gsig shed shugs yod pa dang mgo gug bya/ 'theng rdung gnyis pa la lus g.yas su gcu la lag g.yas nam mkhar phyar lag g.yon lte ba'i thad du kha gyen la bstan/ lus dkrug pa sogs 'dra/ 'theng rdung gsum pa la lag gnyis g.yas zur du brkyangs lus nem che zhing g.yas phyogs dkrug gsig shed bskyed la de nas dgu rdeg la lag gnyis rol stabs kyis g.yas nas mdun la bskor/ bdun brgyad ces pa'i dus g.yas phyir bsdu zhing g.yon mdun la bskor/ lag gnyis pad skor ltar byas la thugs kar mnyam pa dang / dgu zhes dang rnga che ba gcig gi dus lus nem che ba la lag g.yas g.yas phyogs kyi nam mkhar phyar zhing dkrug gsig shed che ba/ mjug tu 'theng rdung gnyis gong dang 'dra/ de nas che ba gcig la lag gnyis so sor mdun du bzhag 'cham tshul 'di gong bka' bsgo dang / phur kha bsgyur ba sogs dgu rdung bzlog pa'i rol mo lta bu gang la yang rigs 'gre shes par bya/ phur gdab rdzogs mtshams rol mo gsum rdeg lan bcas byas la rol mo rnams so sor bzhag srung 'khor bsgom pa ni/ dpon slob thams cad kyis sgrub thabs ltar/ steng yang rdo rje'i bla bre la/ /zhes pa nas bhañja ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pa me ri'i sngags kyi bar phyag rgya dbyangs dang bcas pa phyag len bzhin bya ba'o// ༈ /spyi don gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal te bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyis mjug bsdu ba la/ phyag rgya'i gar 'cham gyi sgo nas bskyed pa'i rten gzhal yas khang dang / brten pa lha'i tshogs rnams dang rang yab yum la thim/ yum yang yab la thim/ rang nyid snying ga'i hūm̐ la thim/ hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la thim/ mgo bo zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da de yang je phra je phra la song nas mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba bzhin mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/

zhes brjod cing bsgom pa ni rtag pa'i mtha' bsal/ rang nyid chu las nya 'phar tshul gyis skad cig gis rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi skur gyur/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kā wa tse hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod la lus bsrung zhing rdo rje'i go gyon par bsam pa ni chad pa'i mtha' bsal ba'o/ /bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyis mjug bsdu ba rnams cho ga'i rjes chog dang bstun nas mdzad/ de nas chas gos rnams bzhag la cho ga'i mjug srung ma rnams la bskang ba/ bstod pa/ tshogs/ mgyogs gtor 'bul ba sogs so so'i phyag len bzhin byas la/ ye shes lnga ldan gyi dngos grub blang ba nas bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis kyi bar bya ba ste sa chog gi skabs su dgos pa'i bskyed rim phyag rgya'i gar 'cham sa lo chen pos phyag len ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin cha lag dang bcas pa mtha' dag bstan zin to// ༈ /nub tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa dang bstun dgra bgegs brub kyi 'cham gyi phyag len rim pa la sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes so/ /dang po sngon 'gro rnga 'cham gyi rim pa ni/ dkyil 'khor chen po bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i tshul gyis bsgrub cing mchod pa sogs nas bdag 'jug blangs te yi dam chos srung rnams la mchod gtor 'bul ba dang / deng sang bskang gso bstod pa rnams sbyin bdag dang bstun mdzad dgos pas/ gtor bsngos kyi bshags pa grub mtshams tshogs byin brlabs nas tshogs bar pa yan phyag len bzhin song nas rnal 'byor pa rnams rdo rje gzhon nu'i nga rgyal dang ldan bzhin pas/ sngar bzhin chas gos gyon zhing sna zhur sogs bya/ ban phur tshab tu rnga rnga yog dang bcas pa lag tu thogs/ rnga rdung ba rnams kyis sbug chal dang / brub 'cham la dgos pa'i rnga dang / mchod g.yog pas liṅga ras la bcos pa'i khog par rgyu ma 'dom gsum tsam gsum gyi sne drug la smyug ma'i sbubs sor bzhi tsam gyi rgyu ma dbugs kyis 'bud chas re sbrags pa/

snying gar khrag gis gang ba'i grod thum srab mo shin tu brgyangs pa phur rtse reg pa tsam gyis khrag nam mkhar 'phyong nas khrom kun gyis mthong ba'i zil yong ba/ dpral bar zho khrag bsres pa'i thum khro bcu'i phur pa kun 'dus skra mtshams nas dpral bar btsugs pa dang / khyad par gdab kha drug pa'i dus tho bas brdungs pa'i tshe klad pa 'thor ba lta bu'i nyams yong ba/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i dus 'cham pa tshang ma la 'gyed rgyu'i sha dmar dum tshal mang ba sogs phyag len bzhin bcug pa'i bzo khyad can zhags pa nag pos bsdams pa/ ling gdan ras la bris pa'i mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi shin tu rngam zhing che ba'i snying gar 'brub khung nag po me ri 'bar ba'i rtse mgo phyogs bstan pa bris pa'i dbus su nṛḥ triḥ zhes pa bris pa/ spos phor gu gul dang bcas pa/ lcog chung gcig gi steng du rdor dril/ lcags kyi phur chung shin tu rno ba gsum ni gtso phur/ khro bo bcu kun 'dus kyi gcig phra thabs nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi rnams kun 'dus kyi phur pa gcig ste gsum mo/ /sgrol gri/ gong 'og tu dgos pa'i thun nyung gi spar bu/ rdo rje tho ba sogs dang / 'cham dpon la khyi gdong / gzhan rnams la phra thabs dang sgo ma sogs kyi zhal 'bag rnga ma sngo dmar ljang nag bzhi dang / dar sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'cham dpon la phyag mtshan ral gri gzhan rnams la mngon rtogs bzhin dang / g.yon thams cad ban+dha lcang lo can no/ /gzhan gri bzang po dang lag shag sogs mu cor gyi mtshan ma mi bya zhing / bla ma'i phyag len gyis spros pa la log lta med pa'i sgo nas ma nyams pa spang blang ma 'dzol ba bstan dgra 'dul ba'i nga rgyal drag po yi dam lha'i rnam pa gsal ba'i ngang nas sngon la dar pa/ dung rgya gling pa/ hwa shang dpon g.yog spos sna ba/ phud chang gi dngul dam phor sogs kyi rjes la 'cham pa dang / rnga rdung ba rnams rim pas phebs/ 'cham rar ma phebs tsam la sa chog gi rtsa 'cham bzhin gong gi lag khyer ba rnams 'khyams yod sar brdzangs la/

de nas 'cham pa rnams sngar bzhin 'cham sna ba nas brtsams te gral bar thag snyoms shing cung yangs par byas la rnga yu brla g.yon pa'i steng du btsugs/ rnga yog rnams kyis ber thon tsam brdungs la dal bus g.yas phyogs su 'cham/ de nas rnga chig rdung dal bus bya zhing / rnga skad re dang bstun lus nem zhing gsig la rkang g.yas btegs/ lag g.yon gru mo ma gug par rnga g.yon phyogs brgyangs/ rnga skad gcig la 'gro phyogs phab/ de bzhin rkang g.yon rgyab nas bskor te g.yon zur 'gro phyogs bgrad nas bzhag la lus gsig pa sogs 'dra/ rnga g.yon nas mdun/ g.yon phyogs bskor zhing rnga g.yas phyogs bya bsnyal dang rnga yu brla g.yon steng 'dzugs pa gong bzhin no/ /de lta bu rnga skad re la rkang pa g.yas g.yon re mos dang / rnga dang rnga yog gi 'khyer dod pa lus sked ldem legs shing 'cham tshul mdzes la lus 'drong pa rang gtso bor byed pa ni rnga 'cham gyi khyad chos dam pa'o/ /de mthun rnga bya bsnyal dang phyi bsgyur nang bsgyur sogs mkhas la 'grig pa dgos so/ /de lta bu'i dal 'gros skor gcig song rjes/ 'cham dpon gyis brda sprod kyi rnga shed che ba gcig brdungs la/ de nas thams cad kyis rnga gsum rdeg lan can che ba gcig byas rjes/ rnga rnga yog dang bcas lag pa g.yas kyi sta zur g.yas su bya bsnyal legs shing bar thag dang mtho dma' snyoms par bzung / lag g.yon sked gzer dang lus cung zad 'gying zhing bsdad/ rnga rdung ba rnams gdan la gral byas te 'dug hwa shang lag khyer ba dang bcas pa gang 'os su 'khod/ de nas sngon 'gro yang 'brel so drug gi nang nas/ gser skyems gtor ba/ phur kha bsgyur ba/ lha srung spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba/ gsal ba gsum dang gdengs gsum gsal btab ste nga rgyal bskyed pa/ ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs pa rnams mdzad pas/ de la thog mar 'cham dang dbyangs kyi rnam gzhag tsam la/ gser skyems kyi skabs su bsdus pa ni 'cham dpon gyis byings drangs/

rnga rdung ba'i nang nas skad snyan zhing brjid pa gnyis gsum gcig 'cham dpon gyi drung du langs te mgur 'degs mkhas par bya/ rnga rdung ba gzhan rnams gral la bsdad pa de ga'i ngang nas dbyangs 'then pa ma gtogs thams cad langs na bsod snyoms pa 'dra ba'i mi mdzes pas de ltar dgongs pa'i sgo nas 'cham pa rnga rdung ba dang bcas pa'i dpon slob rnams bsgrigs nas dbyangs snyan zhing gre 'gyur dod la 'grig cing yid khul ba dang bcas pas/ dang po gser skyems la/ gu ru'i snyan dbyangs dang / 'jam po'i 'khyil 'cham lan gsum mdzad pa'i thog ma/ bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mchod/ /zhes tshig gnyis la gu ru'i snyan dbyangs grub mtshams/ rnga rnams lag pa g.yon pas brla rkang g.yon steng bzung / g.yas pas brdung zhing 'cham pa'i thog mar 'cham dpon gyis gong bzhin rnga shed che ba gcig brdungs nas brda sprod pa/ 'cham sna bsgyur mtshams thams cad 'dra/ 'cham dpon ma gtogs thams cad kyis rnga che ba'i brda sprod sogs mi brdung bas dran 'dzin gal che/ chung ba gsum la 'chams nas gsum pa la cung che ba gcig dang bstun rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos de gar bzhag lus nem che bar byas la de nas rnga ber lang tsam shed chung la dal ba drug gis bar snyoms par brdungs/ rnga skad re dang bstun rkang g.yas mdun nas drud cing sgyid ldem lus gsig dang bcas pas bskor te kha dang rnga phyir bstan/ rnga rnga yog dang bcas pa brgyangs nas rkang g.yas btegs la 'gro phyogs bzhag yang rkang g.yon rgyab nas drud cing bskor/ rnga dang kha nang la bltas nas rnga g.yas phyogs phyar zhing rkang g.yon btegs la 'gro phyogs bzhag de bzhin gsum pa la g.yas/ bzhi pa la g.yon/ lnga pa la g.yas rnams gong bzhin la/ drug ces pa'i dus rnga che zhing sa la ma reg tsam mnan la mdun nas bskor zhing rkang g.yon btegs te 'gro phyogs su bzhag rkang g.yas mdun nas gong bzhin drud cing bskor la/

kha dang rnga rgyab phyogs rang la bstan zhing / rnga g.yon zur du brgyangs nas phyar la yang chung zhing dal ba drug gi bar la rgyab phyogs 'gro ba ma gtogs/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon re mos byed pa 'dra ba las gsum pa'i dus rnga che ba brdung la rkang g.yas rgyab 'gro phyogs phab cing rnga thad kar phyar sgyid ldem shin tu che ba byed pa tsam snga rting gi khyad par ro/ /drug gi dus rnga'i 'khyer sogs gong bzhin la rkang g.yon rgyab kyi 'gro phyogs phab/ de nas rnga gsum gyi dang po la rkang g.yas btegs shing rgyab phyogs bzhag gnyis pa la rkang g.yon btegs shing mdun gyi 'gro phyogs bzhag gsum pa la rnga che ba brdung zhing kha do ra'i nang la blta/ rkang g.yas btegs la g.yas zur bgrad nas bzhag pa ste 'jam po'i 'khyil 'cham mo/ /de ltar gnyis pa ni/ khyad par phur bu'i lha tshogs mchod/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yis/ /zhes dang / gsum pa la phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /grub gnyis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes pa tsam ma gtogs dbyangs dang 'cham gong dang khyad par med do/ /gnyis pa phur kha bsgyur ba la tshe 'dzin gyi 'gying dbyangs dang / rin po che'i 'dur 'cham lan gsum mdzad pa'i thog ma rnga brla steng g.yon zur bzung / dbyangs dang bstun rnga phyir brdung bya zhing rnga yog skad che chung la dpags pa'i rdung lugs 'khyer sogs mkhas par byas la/ do nub kyi phur kha gnyan po 'di/ steng gi lha la mi ston no/ /lha gshegs gangs dkar rtse la gshegs/ /phur lam gnyan po da phye zhig /zhes pa la tshe 'dzin gyi 'gying dbyangs grub mtshams/ rnga 'dzin tshul brda sprod pa gong bzhin byas nas/ rnga cung chung ba lnga phyi rgyag bya ste/ de yang rnga yu brla g.yon steng btsugs pa'i ngang nas rnga g.yas zur phyogs la gcus te sked pa'i thad tsam du yong bar byas la gsum gyi bar la chung snyoms 'cham pa'i tshul du brdung la rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos lus nem gsig byas la 'gro phyogs de kar bzhag

bzhi lnga zhes pa bstud de myur bar brdung zhing rnga sa la mnan nas glo bur du rnga bsgyur zhing nam mkhar bslangs/ mdun nas brdungs te lag g.yon mdun ngos 'gro phyogs brgyang / nang nas chung snyoms lan lnga brdung ba dang bstun gcig la rkang pa g.yas btegs shing 'gro phyogs bzhag sgyid ldem lus gsig yod tsam bya/ de bzhin gnyis la rkang g.yon/ gsum la rkang g.yas btegs 'gro phyogs bzhag cing gong bzhin nem pa dang rkang g.yon cung zad btegs la rkang g.yas kyi rting pa'i rgyab tu rtse mo sa la btsugs/ bzhi lnga gong ltar mgyogs myur brdungs la lus nem pa sogs 'dra/ yang rnga yu brla g.yon steng btsugs la chung lnga'i gcig la rkang g.yas btegs nas phyi 'gros kyis rkang g.yon gyi rgyab tsam du sa la bzhag rnga phyi bsgyur du brdung sgyid ldem sogs 'dra/ gnyis la rkang g.yon gong bzhin rkang g.yas kyi rgyab phyogs su bzhag rnga bsgyur 'og nang nas brdungs/ gsum la rkang g.yas gong bzhin bzhi lnga la gong ltar mgyogs myur phyir rdung byas la/ rkang g.yon btegs tsam byas nas 'gro phyogs bzhag lus nem gsig bya'o/ /de 'dra ba phar mdun 'gro phyogs dang / de'i lan phyir rgyab 'gros/ rnga phyi bsgyur nang bsgyur sogs gong dang 'dra ba lan gsum gyis gsum pa'i rgyab 'gros tshab tu chos 'byung rtse 'gro phyogs bstan pa bri ste/ rnga shin tu che ba lnga'i gcig gis rnga phyir brdungs la/ rkang g.yas mdun ngos su bzhag gnyis pa la rnga nang rdung dang / rkang pa g.yon rgyab phyogs su bzhag pa zur gnyis dang / gsum pa la rnga phyir rdung dang bstun 'gro phyogs su bgrad rgyag ngos rtse mdun 'gro phyogs bstan pa 'bri tshul dang / lus nem gsig shin tu che bar byas la/ bzhi lnga gong bzhin mgyogs myur brdungs nas rkang g.yon btegs kha rgyab phyogs blta zhing rgyab kyi 'gro phyogs su phab/ yang chung ba lnga'i gcig la rkang g.yas btegs nas/

rkang g.yon mdun du bzhag rkang g.yas kyi sgyid par rkang g.yon gyi pus mo btsugs te sked pa bsrangs nas gnyis gsum zhes pa'i bar 'gying nas sdod/ bzhi lnga zhes pa gong bzhin brdungs/ rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos de gar bzhag yang chung lnga'i gcig la rkang g.yas btegs nas phyir 'gros kyis rkang g.yon gyi rgyab tsam du bzhag cing rnga phyir brdungs sgyid ldem byab/ gnyis nas lnga'i bar dang / yang lnga'i bar la mdun la rkang pa re mos kyis 'gro ba'i lan dang / yang rgyab mdun la 'gro ba gnyis te lan gsum bskyar nas byed pa'i 'cham tshul gong dang 'dra ba byas rjes/ rnga che ba lnga'i gcig la rkang g.yas phyir rgyab tu bzhag gnyis pa la rkang g.yon mdun phyogs bzhag gsum pa la rkang g.yas rgyab kyi sngar shul bzhag pa ste zur gnyis/ bzhi lnga gong bzhin brdung la rkang g.yon rgyab kyi 'gro phyogs bgrad la bzhag pa rtse rgyab bstan 'bri tshul te chos 'byung ltag sprod yin/ de nas cung che ba lnga'i gsum gyi bar rnga brgyangs nas nang rdung ngos gcig la rkang g.yas btegs nas phyir bskor te rgyab tu bzhag gnyis la rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs bzhag gsum pa la kha do ra'i nang la bltas la rkang g.yas g.yas su bzhag bzhi lnga la gong bzhin phyir rdung byas la bzhag pa ste rin po che'i 'dur 'cham zhes pa'o/ /rgyab mdun du rnga phyi bsgyur nang bsgyur gyi 'gro ba la shang shang 'gros zhes zer lags/ de ltar gnyis pa la/ do nub kyi༞ bar gyi btsan la༞ btsan gshegs brag dmar logs la gshegs/ /phur lam༞ zhes dang / gsum pa la/ do nub kyi༞ 'og gi klu༞ klu gshegs rgya mtsho'i gting la gshegs/ /phur lam༞ zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs dbyangs dang 'cham tshul gong dang khyad par med do/ /gsum pa lha srung spyan drang ba la 'cham dbyangs med/ bzhi pa gsal ba gsum dang gdengs gsum gsal btab cing nga rgyal bskyed pa la bde ba'i brjid dbyangs dang /

nor bu'i skor 'cham lan gsum mdzad pa'i thog ma rnga 'dzin tshul gong dang 'dra ba las/ dbyangs dang bstun 'og nang nas brdung zhing ban gsig cung zad bya zhing / rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba ni/ hūm̐ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin/ /thugs nang 'bar ba'i srog kyang zhugs/ /zhes pa la bde ba'i brjid dbyangs grub mtshams/ rnga'i brda sprod sogs 'dra/ de nas bzhi rdung chung ba'i gcig gnyis la g.yas zur du rnga yo ba dang bcas pas 'cham/ gsum la rnga sa la mnan zhing rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos mdun nas bskor la de gar phab/ lus nem gsig yod pa bya/ bzhi la rnga dang rkang g.yas btegs/ bzhi rdung gi gcig la kha dang rnga rgyab phyogs la cung zad blta zhing rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs rkang g.yon gyi mdun du bzhag gnyis la 'gyings/ gsum bzhi la rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos de gar phab pa sogs gong bzhin la rnga rgyab nas dal bus bskor/ yang bzhi rdung gi gcig la kha dang rnga mdun phyogs la blta/ rkang g.yas g.yas zur du bzhag de bzhin du rnga nyal stabs su 'khyer ba de 'dra ba'i 'cham tshul bzhi rdung chung snyoms bdun gyi bar byas la/ bdun pa'i gsum bzhi la rnga dang lus nem gsig shin tu che zhing rkang g.yon btegs nas g.yon 'gro phyogs 'phyong shing bzhag yang bzhi rdung gcig la rkang g.yas btegs te kha rgyab la blta ba sogs gong dang 'dra/ yang bzhi rdung gcig la gong bzhin rnga g.yas zur 'khyer zhing rkang g.yas phab/ kha mdun phyogs blta zhing gsum bzhi la rnga che zhing g.yon phyogs 'phyong ba sogs 'dra/ yang bzhi rdung dang kha rgyab phyogs blta ba/ bzhi rdung gcig la kha mdun phyogs blta zhing g.yon 'phyong 'dra ba las/ bzhi rdung che ba la 'phyong gsig shin tu che ba'i ngos chos 'byung kha phyir bstan bri ste/ de yang gcig la rnga dang rkang g.yas glo bur btegs nas 'gro phyogs bzhag pa zur gcig gnyis la rkang g.yon btegs/ gsum la rgyab ngos su bgrad nas bzhag pa rtse dang /

bzhi la rkang g.yas btegs/ bzhi rdung chung ba'i gcig la rgyab phyogs kyi 'gro phyogs bzhag pa zur gcig 'bri tshul byas la rkang g.yas kyi sgyid khung du g.yon gyi pus mo btsugs la gnyis la 'gyings/ gsum bzhi la rkang g.yon btegs tsam kha phyir bstan de ga'i ngang nas g.yas zur du rnga yo ba dang bcas 'gro phyogs phab pa sogs gong dang 'dra ba'i bzhi rdung chung snyoms drug dang / g.yon 'phyong gnyis rnams gong dang 'dra/ che bzhi'i gcig la rkang g.yas rgyab tu bgrad nas bzhag pas rtse dang gnyis la rkang g.yon btegs nas gsum la mdun ngos kyi g.yon zur du bzhag pa zur gcig bzhi la rkang g.yas btegs kha mdun la bltas nas rnga che ba gcig la g.yas zur bzhag pa zur gcig 'bri tshul te chos 'byung kha phyir bstan gnyis bri ba ste nor bu'i skor 'cham mo/ /kha phyir bstan nang bstan gyi 'cham tshul shes pa gal che'o/ /de ltar gnyis pa la/ tshigs brgyad spyi bor rkang mthil rnams/ /khro bo khro mo'i bdag nyid gnas/ /zhes dang / gsum pa la rtogs pa lta ba'i gdengs ni/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /ma lus khro rgyal nyid kyi ngang / /zhes pa tsam ma gtogs dbyangs dang 'cham gong dang khyad par med do/ /lnga pa ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs la/ rdo rje'i 'tsher dbyangs dang / dpag bsam gyi 'jol 'cham lan gsum mdzad pa'i thog ma la rnga 'dzin tshul sked gzer sogs gong gser skyems bzhin byas la/ rgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin dang / /zhes tshig dang po rdzogs mtshams/ rnga 'dzin tshul brda sprod sogs gser skyems bzhin byas la/ nga'i nga'i zhes pa gnyis la rnga 'chams nas nga 'a zhes pa la lus dang rnga cung zad nem rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos 'gro phyogs bzhag rkang g.yas mdun nas sa la drud cing dal bus bskor/ rnga dang kha rgyab phyogs blta zhing dbyangs dang bstun rnga cung zad brdung la/ yi zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas btegs tsam byas la bzhag

yang rkang g.yas btegs la ya'i 'a 'a zhes pa'i dus 'gro phyogs bzhag de bzhin dam la rkang g.yon rgyab nas drud cing btegs tsam byas la 'gro phyogs bzhag 'a 'am zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs rnga dang lus nem kha nang la blta zhing ma'i 'a'i dus 'gro phyogs phab/ zhi 'i zhes pa'i dus rnga g.yas zur rgyab phyogs nye bar phyi rdung rkang g.yas btegs lus nem che zhing sgyid ldem legs par byas la de gar phab/ yang rkang g.yas btegs/ ya'i 'e 'e zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas g.yas zur phab/ yang rkang g.yon btegs rnga mdun phyogs nem tsam ngos g.yon phyogs brgyangs shing 'og nang nas brdungs/ khro zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs phab pa'i zhes pa'i dus kyang rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos de khar phab/ ba 'a 'a zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas btegs lus nem gsig che zhing rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs phab pa'i ya'i zhes pa'i dus/ yang rkang g.yas btegs tsam byas la 'gro phyogs bzhag rab ces pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs tsam lus gsig dang bcas pas de gar phab/ 'a 'am zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs rnga dang lus nem kha nang la blta zhing / ma'i 'a 'i 'i dus 'gro phyogs phab/ 'byams 'a 'am zhes pa'i dus rnga g.yas zur rgyab phyogs nye bar phyir brdungs/ rkang g.yas btegs lus nem che zhing sgyid ldem legs par byas la de gar phab/ yang rkang g.yas btegs/ ma'i 'e 'e zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas g.yas zur phab/ tshogs zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs 'gro phyogs bzhag kha nang la blta zhing rnga nang rdung bya/ ba'i ba'i zhes pa'i dus rnga shed che ba brdungs la rnga g.yon zur sa la phab/ rnga yu lag pa g.yas pa'i gru mo'i 'og tu yong bar byas la thur rdung chung snyoms bzhi byas/ yang chung bzhi la rnga g.yas zur phyar/ rnga yu g.yon phyogs gang bab bstan la gyen brdung bya/ de bzhin lan gsum byas nas thur rdung che ba bzhi'i bar la lus gsig cing mnan la/ de nas 'theng rdung che ba gnyis la rkang g.yon dang rnga btegs tsam btegs tsam ngos mdun nas g.yas phyogs bskor zhing sa la phab tsam phab tsam bya/

rkang g.yas yang g.yon dang 'dra bar mnyam por bskor la kha rgyab la blta/ yang gong bzhin bzhi rdung gcig gi gcig dang gnyis che ba dang gsum bzhi chung bar brdungs/ rnga g.yon zur 'bebs pa dang / g.yas zur 'degs pa dang / g.yon zur 'bebs pa rnga chung brdung ba sogs gong bzhin lan gsum song rjes/ che ba bzhi la rnga thur rdung ngos rkang pa g.yas rgyab nas sa la drud cing bskor g.yon zhar byung du bskor nas kha nang la blta/ de nas rdo rje ltar bzhi rdung bya zhing rnga dang rkang g.yas btegs mdun nas bskor zhing g.yon zur gyi rgyab la nye bar phab lus ban gsig shin tu che ba dang bcas rtse gsum gyi g.yon ra bri/ yang bzhi rdung che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs g.yon zur gyi mdun la nye bar bzhag la g.yas ra bri/ yang bzhi rdung che ba gcig la rkang g.yas ra gnyis kyi bar 'gro lam du bzhag ste dbus ra 'bri tshul bya/ ra rnams 'bri dus rkang g.yon g.yas kyi rgyab tu btegs tsam re dang lus gsig rnga 'og nang rdung kho na bya/ mig dang zhwa thebs g.yon zur mnan/ de nas rnga bsgyur zhing phyir rdung bzhi rdeg shin tu che ba gcig la rnga dang rkang g.yas btegs/ mdun nas bskor zhing kha mdun bstan ngos rkang g.yon 'phar chung bya zhing rgyab 'phyong shin tu che zhing lus sgyid ldem legs shing ban gsig che bar byas la gnyis zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas g.yas kyi rgyab zur du phab pa rtse gsum gyi yu ba 'bri tshul dang / rkang g.yon btegs/ gsum gyi dus mdun la bskor nas g.yas kyi pus mo'i thad tsam du btegs/ rkang g.yas 'phar chung phyir 'gros bya/ bzhi la rkang g.yon 'gro phyogs phab/ yang che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs rnga bsgyur zhing brgyangs te nang mdun nas brdungs la 'phyong che ba'i ngos 'gro phyogs phab/ de bzhin du che ba gnyis pa la rkang g.yon btegs 'phyong shing 'gro phyogs phab ste rtse gsum 'gros zhes zer/

de lta bu'i rtse gsum bri ba lan lnga'am bdun la sogs pas rkang g.yas kho nas 'bri ba ste dpag bsam gyi 'jol 'cham mo/ /de ltar gnyis pa la/ khyad par phur bu'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /zhes dang / gsum pa la/ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pas/ /de ltar legs par bzung du gsol/ /zhes pa tsam ma gtogs dbyangs dang 'cham tshul gong dang khyad par med do/ /dpag bsam gyi 'jol 'cham gsum pa'i rtse gsum 'gros grub mtshams/ 'cham pa rnams kyis rnga dang bstun sbug chal dkrol/ dung rol mo che chung dang mthun par bus shing rol mo 'theng rdung chung ba gcig la rnga yu brla g.yon par btsugs nas g.yas phyogs g.yos zhing 'og nas brdungs/ gnyis pa la rnga yu gong bzhin la g.yon phyogs g.yos zhing phyi bsgyur gyi steng nas rdungs/ de bzhin g.yas g.yon re mos kyis lan lnga'i bar la dzam bya zhing lus cung zad gsig de nas rol mo 'theng rdung dang lus ban gsig che bar 'gro phyogs 'phyong zhing rnga bya bsnyal 'grig pa'i rkang g.yas btegs shing g.yas 'phyong dus rnga phyir brdung dang g.yon du g.yos zhing kha phyir blta/ g.yon gyi dus rnga nang rdung dang g.yas su g.yos zhing kha nang la blta ba ste re mos byas la 'cham dpon rang gis dbus su skor ba gcig lhag tsam gyi bar du 'gros 'cham bya zhing rdzogs mtshams g.yon phyogs ngos rnga g.yas phyogs 'og rdung dang g.yas su g.yos pa de ga'i ngang nas 'cham dpon gyis shed chung bas myur du brdungs la brda sprad cing / gong bzhin 'theng rdung chung ba lnga la dzam byas la/ rdo rje phyed 'gros/ rkyang 'gros/ rgya gram rnams gong rtsa ba'i 'cham dang 'dra ba las/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par phyag mtshan dang 'gros yin te/ de la dzam rdzogs pa'i 'theng rdung rting ma la 'theng rkang mi byed par gcig gi rjes la che ba gnyis bstud brdungs shing lus gsig che ba dang bcas rnga phyir rdung bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/

mdun nas bskor zhing g.yon gyi rgyab zur du phab nas g.yon ra bri/ yang bzhi rdung che ba gcig la rnga 'og nas brdungs ngos rkang g.yas btegs mdun gyi g.yon zur bzhag g.yas ra bri/ yang bzhi rdung che ba gcig la rnga steng nas phyir rdung dang rkang g.yas btegs/ ra gnyis kyi bar 'gro lam du bzhag dbus ra 'bri tshul bya/ de nas bzhi rdung chung ba gcig la rkang g.yas mdun nas bskor la lte ba 'bri tshul dang / sked gzer tshab rnga nang rdung ngos kha do ra'i nang la blta zhing g.yas phyogs phyar/ g.yas 'phyong g.yon 'phyong la rnga 'gro phyogs phyar la nang rdung bya/ yang bzhi rdeg che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs g.yas kyi mdun zur phab/ rnga 'og nang nas brdung de bzhin g.yon ra 'bri dus rnga phyir brdungs/ dbus ra 'bri dus rnga nang rdung byed pa tsam las gzhan gong dang 'dra/ de lta bu lnga'am bdun sogs bya/ 'jog pa dang g.yon 'phyong dang bstun kha nang la bltas la gong bzhin rnga myur rdung gis brda sprad nas dzam dang 'gros gong bzhin skor gcig grub nas rdo rje rkyang 'gros la brda sprod dzam sogs 'dra ba las/ dzam byed dus kha g.yas phyogs su bltas la ra 'bri dus rkang pa g.yas pas g.yas ra 'bri dus rnga phyir brdungs/ de bzhin gong ltar rnga phyi bsgyur nang bsgyur re mos kyis ra bris tshar ba dang / rnga skad che ba gcig la rkang g.yas btegs/ rgyab nas bskor te 'gro phyogs phab/ yang rnga che ba gcig la rkang g.yon btegs kha 'gro phyogs blta/ rkang g.yon g.yas mdun du bzhag rnga 'og nas brdungs shing g.yas ra 'bri tshul sogs rdo rje phyed 'gros kyis g.yon gyi bri ba dang 'dra/ don rkang g.yas kyis bri ba'i thog ma rnga phyir brdungs/ rkang g.yon gyis thog ma 'bri dus rnga 'og rdung yin no/ /de ltar gsum bzhi lnga sogs grub nas/ brda sprod dzam 'gros sogs gong dang 'dra/ de bzhin rdo rje rgya gram yang rigs 'gre shes par byas la gnyis sam gsum la sogs pa grub mtshams/

brda sprod dzam 'gros sogs 'dra bas/ 'gros de ga'i ngang la 'cham dpon gyi rjes la 'cham sna ba mthud nas 'gro ba je myur je myur shin tu 'grigs pa'i ngos nang sogs ji ltar rigs par log go /de ltar ni sngon 'gro rnga 'cham gyi rim pa bstan zin to// ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi dgra bgegs brub kyi 'cham dngos bstan pa ni/ gong du 'dus byas pa'i ras ling de/ skya min ser min rnam rtog chung zhing nyams dod pa zhig gis khrom gseb ji ltar rigs par sbas nas bzung / ling gdan ras bris ma 'cham dpon gyi bzhugs gdan mdun du mgo bo phyir bstan la gding / de'i g.yon 'cham dpon gyi g.yas phyogs su lcog chung steng du bkod pa'i rdor dril sogs gdab las kyi chas rnams bzhag spos phor du me sogs yong bar bya/ de nas 'cham dpon gyis ban phur dang / mchod g.yog pas phud chang 'thor ba'i phyir 'cham chas de ga'i ngang nas rnga rdung pa rnams dang lhan cig ling stan gyi 'khris su byon nas cho ga tshang ba'i phyir gser skyems gtang ba ni/ gong gi lag khyer ba'i dngul dam phor khyer ba'i lag nas dkar gzugs mchod g.yog pas blang / dngul dam nas phud chang cung zad blugs pa lag g.yas kyis bzung / g.yon ban phur yod na lhan cig bzung ba'i sked gzer ngos/ rol mo dang bstun lag g.yas kyis 'chams shing / dpon slob rnams kyis mngon rtogs bzhin bdud rtsi byin rlabs mdzad nas rol mo bsgrigs te gsum rdeg lan bcas mdzad dus 'cham tshul yod pa lhun chags pa bya/ de nas dbyangs dang bstun rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs 'degs dus lag g.yas mdun nas bskor dpung g.yon thad tsam du yong ba bya/ 'bebs dus lag g.yas 'gro phyogs mnan/ yang rkang g.yon 'degs dus lag pas mdun nas bskor zhing dpung g.yas su phyar/ 'bebs dus lag g.yas g.yas zur du mnan pa sogs kyi dus su sked ldem yod tsam bya/ de bzhin dbyangs ma rdzogs bar rkang pa gnyis gnyis rdeg ma 'chugs pa bya/

gsum rdeg dus ban ling dang mjug gi gcig rdeg dus phyogs mtshams steng 'og chos srung gzhi bdag gang gnas su phul bar bsam/ 'cham chas lag khyer sogs gang la'ang ma gnod par byas la rtog pa gang zhib kyis gtor/ rdzogs mtshams su rol mo chem rdung dang bstun sa la lan gsum gtor nas rang yang cung zad gcig btung / dkar gzugs sogs phud phor chus bshal ba'i bkod pa gtsang sbra thon pa dgos so/ /gser skyems ni/ bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod/ /sogs bsdus pa bzhin dang rig 'dzin bskul ba sgrub thabs bzhin/ phur kha bsgyur ba ni/ do nub kyi phur kha gnyan po 'di/ /sogs/ lha srung spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba'i dgug gzhug lan gsum sngags bcas tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba'i dmigs pa rnams 'og tu mdzad pas 'dir mi dgos/ spyan drang ba ni/ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka /sogs nas oṃ badz+ra aṅgu sha dzaḥdzaḥzhes pa'i bar bya/ gsal ba gsum dang gdeng gsum gsal gdab cing nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin/ /sogs rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba/ khro bo khro mo phra men dang / /nas/ dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs/ /sogs kyis gnyen po lha'i gdengs/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/ /tshig gnyis kyis rtogs pa lta ba'i gdengs/ kī la ya ste mgo gnon sngags kyi gdengs/ dīp+ta tsakra phur pa'i lha/ /sogs phur pa sras mchog tu gsal ba/ liṅga bsgral yul bzas pa po/ /sogs liṅga bzas pa por gsal ba rnams so/ /ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs pa ni/ rgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin dang / /sogs sngon 'gro'i tshig rigs rnams sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi lhan thabs bzhin no/ /de nas mchod g.yog pa 'cham khang du log rdo rje slob dpon/ rnga rdung ba/ dung rgya gling / dar pa sogs lag khyer ba rnams dang bcas/ 'cham khang gi sgo sogs 'byon sa'i gdong der rnga rdung ba phyogs gcig dang /

lag khyer ba gzhan tsho zhal sprod tshul du bsgrigs/ spos phor sogs su me tsha ba la gu gul/ sha chen/ tshil chen sogs kyi dud pa na bun 'thibs pa lta bu shin tu zil che bar bsreg de nas rol mo dung sogs 'bud dkrol rngam brjid ldan pa 'chams shing gsum rdung lan bcas grub mtshams hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin gyi dbyangs dang bcas pas/ sa lo chen pos mdzad pa'i bskul rnams rim pa bzhin las/ dang po ni/ hūm̐ rab brjid rngam pa'i zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs/ /dmar ser skra brdzes thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs 'dzin yang sprul nyi shu po/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i slad du gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhes dbyangs rdzogs nas gsum rdeg lan bcas grub mtshams/ dzam nyug pa gnyis kyis sgo 'khris nas g.yon zur phyir bstan nas lag g.yas thur la brgyangs/ lag g.yon g.yob pa'i tshul dang ban gsig cung zad kyis bzhi rdung chung ba gsum la 'chams te/ bzhi rdung cung che ba gcig la rnga ma rgyab phyogs dkrug cing ban gsig che bas kha nang la blta zhing rkang g.yas rgyab kyi g.yas zur bzhag rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos de gar phab/ lag gnyis yangs pa'i pad skor steng phyogs phyar zhing rgyab g.yas zur du bya/ yang bzhi rdung gcig la kha khrom phyogs blta zhing rnga ma mdun phyogs dkrug cing thur la mnan/ rkang g.yas mdun du bskor zhing g.yon zur phab/ de mthun lag gnyis yangs pad 'og la mnan cing g.yon zur du phab/ yang bzhi rdung gcig la gong bzhin kha nang bstan gyi yangs pad grub mtshams/ sgyid ldem lus gsig che ba dang lag gnyis brgyang / dgu rdung che ba'i gcig dang gnyis la rkang g.yas btegs lag g.yas cung zad g.yob cing khrom phyogs 'phyong / gsum dang bzhi la rkang g.yon btegs nas 'phyong ba sogs nyis sgrong re mos ngos/ dgu la mdun gyi g.yon zur du rkang lag g.yas pa phab nas mgo dkrug shin tu che ba'i rnga ral sa la reg cing rol mo'i len rnga skad gcig la lus bsrangs ba dang rnga ma rgyab la bskyur khrom la 'bag gi gdong ngom pa ni pad skor gnyis kyis nyung ba ma gtogs bzlog pa'i dzam 'gros ji lta ba yin/

yang gong bzhin yangs pad gsum dang dgu rdung len gyi rol mo 'cham sogs gong bzhin byas rjes/ bzhi rdung gcig la yangs pad yod tsam gcig byas la/ pu tra'i rnga brdung bya ste/ de'ang dbus kyi pad skor dus 'theng rkang gsum gyi dang po la lag g.yas pus mo g.yas kyi steng tsam du kha gyen bstan brkyang / g.yon nu ma g.yon gyi thad tsam du kha thur bstan bya/ gnyis pa la lag gnyis gong bzhin g.yas g.yon go ldog cing gnyis zhes pa shin tu che zhing mgo dkrugs kyis rnga ma dang lag gnyis sa la reg la khad mdun du phab ngos 'theng rkang gsum pa la rnga ma rgyab phyogs dkrug cing 'bag gdong ngom/ lag mgo gnyis dpung pa'i thad du kha thur du bstan la lus bsigs shing hrang ba'o/ /g.yon gyi pad skor yang 'theng rkang gsum sogs 'cham tshul phal cher gong dang 'dra ba las rnga ma dang lag gnyis sa la gnon pa g.yon du bya/ rnga ma rgyab tu dkrug cing lus thad kar hrang ba 'dra/ 'on kyang lag gnyis sdud pa'i tshe rkang pa sogs lcags 'then lta bur bya/ g.yas kyi dus pad skor sogs 'dra/ sa la g.yas su gnon/ lag gnyis 'then cing sdud pa dang lcags 'then bya/ de'ang lag g.yas g.yas zur du sa la brkyangs/ g.yon pa brang la bzhar nas lag mgo dpung g.yon steng sleb pa dang gru mo g.yon phab cing dpung g.yon rgyab phyogs gcu/ rkang g.yon sa la drud rkang g.yas kyi bol mtshams sleb pa dang sgyid ldem ngos nem gsig che zhing mgo bo bskor nas rnga ma dpung pa phyir rgyab la gang gcu ba'i rgyab phyogs dkrug rnga ral yod na rtser pad skor ltar 'khyir ba gcig dgos/ g.yon la gnon dus lag gnyis sdud tshe gzhan 'dra ba las rkang g.yas sa la 'drud/ rkang g.yon gyi bol mtshams sleb pa sogs 'dra/ 'di la lag gnyis snying gar mnyam sdud byung na gru thag 'then zhes 'cham gyi skyon rang du mdzad pas thugs rig bsgrim dgos so/ /'og tu lcags 'then zhes pa gang byung dus 'cham tshul 'di dran pa gal che/

de ltar 'theng rdung gnyis la g.yon dang g.yas su lcags 'then re grub ma thag rol mo lnga rdung che ba lnga la lag gnyis brgyangs rkang g.yas btegs grangs 'dzin dus rkang rtse sa la reg tsam re byas nas g.yas phyogs bskor zhing mgo dang lag pa mdun du dkrug gsig che ba rdzogs pa dang chung lnga la lag gnyis sked gzer dang rkang g.yas sa la drud cing g.yon skor bya/ lnga rdung chung ba'i lnga pa la shed che ba brdegs pa dang rkang g.yas btegs shing sa la brdabs/ g.yon btegs grangs 'dzin dus rkang rtse sa la reg pa sogs 'cham tshul thams cad 'dra/ 'on kyang che ba la g.yon skor chung ba la g.yas skor sa la rkang g.yon bsdeb pa tsam yin/ de 'dra ba rnga brdung che ba bzhi/ chung ba bzhi ste brgyad rdzogs mtshams gong bzhin yangs pad gsum lcags 'then gnyis byas la che ba re dang cung chung ba re spel ba'i bzhi rdung dang / lus cung zad 'phar zhing rkang g.yas btegs 'phral 'cham don yong sa phyogs la 'phyong che ba dang phab/ g.yon g.yas 'khris su sleb nges 'drud/ lag g.yon rgyab phyogs brgyangs/ g.yas mdun nas bskor zhing sta zur g.yon thad nas g.yas 'gro phyogs la gri kha 'byed pa bzhin phyag mtshan gang yin rdeg pa'i tshul gyis bshugs/ de'i lan g.yon 'phyong dus g.yas rgyab phyogs brgyangs g.yon bshugs tshul gong dang 'dra/ de lta bu bzhi rdung dang bstun 'og gdab kha'i bzhi 'gros dang ma 'khrul ba'i ngos 'cham khang sogs gang yin du log tshar ba dang / dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi bskul bya ste/ sa los mdzad pa'i bstod pa bzhin thams cad ngag 'dris pas 'don pa cung zad bsgyur/ dkar mo ba'i spyan 'dren gyi dbyangs bcug nas/ hūm̐ dur khrod sha za kun gyi gtso/ /rab dkar keng rus 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /dam tshig can la brtser dgongs te/ /nor gyi bdag po yab yum yang / /'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang / /dngos grub bstsal phyir gshegs su gsol/

/zhes dang / rol mo nyis rdeg lan can grub mtshams chem rdung che ba dang / shug pa brgyab de dang bstun dur khrod bdag po yab yum gnyis zil che bar 'phyong rgyug ngos khrom du sleb mtshams rol mo che ba bzhi rdung dang bstun bud med nag mo'i 'cham bzhin bzhi rdung dang po la lag pa g.yas nam mkhar phyar zhing g.yon lte ba'i 'og tsam du spar mo bgrad nas sa phyogs brgyangs/ rkang g.yas btegs nas lus 'phar zhing mgo gug dang ban gsig shin tu che ba g.yas phyogs su bya/ de bzhin du bzhi rdung gnyis pa la g.yon phyogs su lag g.yon nam mkha' dang g.yas sa phyogs la brgyangs rkang g.yon btegs pa sogs g.yas g.yon gyi khyad tsam ma gtogs 'cham tshul 'dra/ g.yas kyi dus kha g.yas phyogs blta/ g.yon gyi dus g.yon phyogs kha bsgyur gnyis ka la mig nam mkhar blta/ bzhi rdung gsum pa dang bzhi pa la lag gnyis sked gzer bya/ gzhan 'cham stabs gong dang 'dra/ de nas 'theng rdung bzhi la thog mar rkang g.yas/ de nas g.yon/ de nas g.yas de nas g.yon te 'theng rdung re dang bstun re mos kyis spar mo 'debs tshul g.yas g.yon re mos kyis bya zhing de mthun rkang pa g.yas g.yon yang re mos kyis btegs nas 'phyong rgyug shin tu che ba bya/ khrom stod du sleb pa dang yab yum gnyis g.yas g.yon la kha phral nas 'cham tshul gong bzhin ras ling gang yod kyi phyogs la brgyugs shing / liṅga'i thad du sleb pa dang / bzhi rdung gi ngang nas khrom gseb phar tshur du liṅga 'khur mi la bskor zhing 'phyong ba gsum song nas gcig gis phyir log nas dgu rdung gcig la brgyug gcig gis de gar g.yas rgyug g.yon rgyug song nas bzhi rdung bzhi'i bar/ rogs la liṅga dgra bo 'di ga na 'dug lta bu'i brda dang mgo gug g.yab mo byed pa dang / rogs kyis kyang gar dang sked gzer byas nas shin tu spro zhing dga' ba'i tshul gyis dgu rdung gcig la rngam zhing 'phyong rgyug drag tu byas nas liṅga yod sar 'gro/

gcig pos kyang gong bzhin brgyug de lta bu lan gsum song rjes/ liṅga yod sa skya min ser min de'i gzan g.yas g.yon du 'then pa sogs ban ling che la shed chung ngos gang 'jem bya/ des kyang gzan 'gebs shing sba ba'i tshul dang / thal mo sbyar nas zhu ba 'bul tshul sogs ya nga ba ltar byed pa ste/ thams cad kyis nyams dod cing ltad mo ston shes pa'i ngos mu cor skra gcal du ma song ba'i rngam brjid che ba'i tshul gyis gzan 'then thengs re la gnyis ka phyogs phyogs su dgu rdung gcig la phyir 'phyong nas bzhi rdung bzhi la lag gnyis gar dang sked gzer gong bzhin byas/ dgu rdung gcig la nang du 'phyong zhing bar du bzhi rdung byed pa sogs gong bzhin lan gnyis bya/ de bar la liṅga 'dzin mkhan gyis gzan gyi 'og tu zhags pa nag po dkris pa gshigs nas gnyis pa'i dus shed dang zhu bas ma thub pa lta bus 'gyel zhing zhags pa'i sne gnyis yab yum la phul ba dang zhags pa'i sne nas 'then zhing dgu rdung dang bzhi rdung ngos gong bzhin khrom phyogs la 'phyong rgyug lan gsum song rjes 'brub khung gting sar bskor nas sleb pa dang bzhi rdung chung ba gsum dang shin tu chung ba gnyis la dzam 'dra ba'i ngang nas ling gdan 'brub khung gi dkyil chos 'byung gi steng du 'gyel nas mgo bo rtser bstan la dkrug brdabs kyis bzhag pa dang har langs kyis kha phyir bltas nas dgu rdung gcig la brgyug yang nang liṅga phyogs kha bltas nas brgyug de nas lag g.yon sked gzer ngos g.yas brkyangs nas dgu rdung gcig la g.yas skor/ de nas g.yas sked gzer g.yon brkyangs nas dgu rdung gcig la g.yon skor byas nas bzhi rdung cung dal tsam re la/ lag gnyis dpung g.yon phyogs la mchod pa ltar lag pa bskor zhing lag mthil gyen bstan gyis 'bul tshul dang rkang g.yas g.yon phyogs btegs/ de ltar g.yas g.yon re mos kyis byas nas nang du log go

/'di ltar zhing skyong chen po dur khrod bdag po yab yum gyi 'cham tshul 'di dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i dus chos skyong srung ma thams cad rgyab dpung du byon nas grogs mdzad par bsam dgos pas 'brel med rang du'ang mi 'gro zhing / gzigs mo 'bul phyir nged rang gi blo la shar nas byas pa lags/ dzam nyug gnyis pa them pa bar 'jug la dbyangs rab brjid rngam pa dang 'dra/ hūm̐ dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i pho nya mo/ /gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i slad du spyan 'dren na/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs shig /zhes rdzogs pa dang rol mo gsum rdeg lan bcas grub nas/ 'theng rdung dal zhing chung ba la dzam nyug pa gnyis them pa'i nang tsam nas g.yon zur phyir bstan nas lag g.yas brgyangs g.yon g.yob tshul ngos 'chams pa gong bzhin byas la/ rol mo 'theng rdung che ba la rnga ma mdun du bkab nas 'bag gi gdong sgrib cing mi ston pa'i tshul byas la lag g.yas rgyab tu bskor ba'i kha nang la blta/ khrom la rgyab bstan nas rkang g.yas btegs kha nang bstan gyis g.yas zur du 'theng rdung gi che ba thog ma la phab/ lus stod gcus nas 'bag gi gdong g.yas zur nas phyir thur la blta zhing 'jigs ston 'dra bas mgo bo nyug tsam bya/ lag g.yas phyir ston/ g.yon nang du brgyangs/ de nas g.yas g.yon go spo ba tsam ma gtogs 'cham tshul ji lta ba bzhin gyis rkang g.yas 'theng rdung gi chung ba la btegs tsam ngos de gar bzhag rkang g.yon kha phyir bstan gyis g.yon zur du phab cing lag g.yon mgo sogs phyir nyug tsam byed pa ste 'theng rkang lnga'i bar byed pa'i bzhi thub rkang pa nyis brgyag la/ lnga pa'i 'theng rkang gi che ba la rkang g.yas nang gi g.yas zur du phab pa 'dra/ chung ba la'ang rol mo che zhing rkang g.yas mi 'degs pa g.yon btegs tsam ngos lus 'phar zhing gsig pa dang de gar shed che bar phab/

'theng rkang drug pa'i che ba la shin tu che ba brdungs/ rkang g.yas btegs rgyab nang nas bskor te glo bur 'phyong zhing them pa rkang gnyis bar du bcug rkang g.yas phyir khrom phyogs su bgrad nas phab/ chung ba la rkang gnyis ma btegs pa lus gsig cing hrang / de ga'i ngang la lag gnyis brgyangs te rnga ma rgyab la dkrug 'bag gi gdong khrom la ngom zhing g.yas nang la gcu g.yon phyir gcu ba rol pa lta bu 'theng rkang cung chung zhing dal ba gsum la g.yas g.yon re mos su gcu zhing 'gying ba ste/ 'di yan them pa bar 'jug yin/ 'cham sar bdun rdung mdzad pa ni lus g.yas nang la gcus nas 'theng rkang gsum pa'i chung ba la yang che ba brdungs/ rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos de gar phab lus 'phar chung gi gsig cing rkang g.yas btegs nas phyir 'phyong / de bzhin lag g.yas dang rnga ma dkrug gsig che ba'i nyis bgrongs g.yas g.yon re mos kyis 'phyong shing bdun zhes pa'i skabs thams cad du g.yon phyogs su sa la mgo bo phab cing / brgyad ces chung ba'i dus rnga ma rgyab la dkrugs 'bag gdong ngom lag g.yon mdun gyi nam mkhar brgyangs te phyar/ g.yas nang phyogs thur la brkyangs/ de 'dra ba gnyis song nas g.yas skor g.yon skor ngos bdun la 'bag ngom sogs gong bzhin byas te gnyis gsum gang dgos byas la nang du log go /dzam nyug gsum pa pu tra'i dgu rdung ni dbyangs gong bzhin la/ hūm̐ 'jigs rung dmar nag me rlung 'khrug pa'i dbus/ /shin tu khros pas dam nyams tshar gcod cing / /sgrub po skyong mdzad dam can bcu gnyis po/ /ma rung gdul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /zhes rdzogs pa dang / rnga gsum rdung lan bcas grub nas bzhi rdung chung zhing dal ba gsum la dzam nyug pa gnyis kyis g.yon zur phyir bstan nas 'chams pa gong dang 'dra/ de nas bzhi rdung che ba la rkang g.yas btegs g.yas zur phyir bstan gyis gang sleb tu 'phyong zhing rkang g.yon sa la drud de g.yas kyi bol 'khris su sleb par bya/

lag g.yas g.yon zur nas g.yas zur phyogs la gri kha 'byed pa bzhin phyir g.yugs/ g.yon sked gzer bya/ yang g.yon 'phyong lag g.yas sked gzer byed pa g.yas g.yon gyi khyad tsam mo/ /yang gong bzhin g.yas su 'phyong ba ste bzhi rdung gsum dang / de nas 'theng rkang shin tu che ba bzhi la/ lus 'phar zhing dkrug gsig che ba'i 'theng rkang dang po la lag g.yas sked gzer dang rkang g.yon btegs/ mdun nas nang phyogs bskor te 'cham yong sa phyogs la 'phyong zhing phab/ lag g.yon mdun phyogs g.yab cing rkang g.yon dang bstun nas phab/ rnga ma sa la reg pa tsam bya/ 'theng rkang gnyis pa la rkang g.yon phyir log gis rgyab tu 'phyong zhing yong sa phyogs phab/ lag g.yon yang rgyab phyogs phyir g.yug cing rnga ma rgyab la dkrug 'bag ngom/ 'theng rkang gsum pa la rkang g.yas 'phar chung dang rkang g.yon btegs shing mdun nang la bskor 'phyong rdzun 'dra ba'i gom rdzus kyis 'phyong lag g.yon g.yob cing 'bebs pa rnga ma dkrug pa ban gsig che ba sogs gong gi rigs 'gre shes pa'i mkhas par bya/ 'theng rkang bzhi pa la rkang g.yas btegs phyi nas bskor yong sa phyogs 'phyong rdzun gyi gom pa chung ngu bcug ngos 'phar zhing lus nem gsig che zhing phab 'phral rol mo che ba gcig dang chung ba gsum ste bzhi rdung gcig la rnga ma rgyab la dkrug 'bag gdong ngom/ lag gnyis brgyangs rkang g.yon btegs 'gro phyogs 'phyong gang che byas phab rkang pa g.yas g.yon re mos kyis btegs tsam btegs tsam ngos rol pa 'dra ba'i g.yas g.yon du cung zad gcu zhing gsig pa ste pu tra'i dzam 'gros yin/ de 'dra ba lan gsum song rjes/ pad skor gsum dang lcags 'then bya tshul gong gi lnga rdung bzhin byas la/ rnga dgu rdung che ba gcig gi gcig dang gnyis la rkang g.yas btegs mdun nas bskor/ de bzhin gsum dang bzhi la rkang g.yon btegs g.yas phab ste skor 'phro de bskor/

lnga la rkang g.yas btegs phyir log tu bskor/ drug la g.yas phab/ bdun la rol mo gnon pa dang rkang g.yon btegs g.yas su 'phyong zhing sgyid ldem ngos lus g.yas phyogs phab ste mnan/ lag gnyis g.yos zhing brgyad dang dgu la g.yon du phab cing lcags 'then bya/ len gyi rol mo chung ba gcig dang bcu yin/ 'theng rkang gcig la g.yas su 'phyong shing lcags 'then bya/ 'di'i log rdzun ma gtogs 'phyong rnams shin tu che zhing g.yas 'phyong dus rkang g.yon sa la drud de g.yas 'khris su sleb pa/ g.yon 'phyong dus rkang g.yas 'drud pa sogs 'dra/ de lta bu'i dgu rdung gis log go /de nas 'cham dpon chas sprod khang par phebs/ rnga rdung ba gzhan rnams kyis mgo brnyan gyi bskul bya ste/ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmig bu'i mgo /sogs sgrub thabs bzhin la kha skong dang 'don pa cung zad bsgyur ba ni/ gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed sogs/ /dam nyams bsgral ba'i slad du gnas 'dir gshegs/ /zhes sh+lau ka gsum rnga tshigs dang bcas pa grub nas/ rol mo 'theng rkang dang bstun/ 'cham sna 'dren mis g.yon zur phyir bstan nas lan gsum gyi bar 'chams pa 'dra/ de nas 'theng rkang che ba dal snyoms dang bstun rim pa bzhin phyir mchongs shing khrom nang la bskor/ lag khyer ba rnams kyang bkod pa legs pa'i khrom skor bya/ 'cham pa rnams rim bzhin g.yas 'phyong 'theng rkang gi che ba la rkang g.yas btegs 'gros phyogs su phab/ rkang g.yon btegs tsam byas nas de gar mnan/ rnga ma bskor nas dkrugs shing 'bag gdong dpung g.yon steng phyogs la blta ba'i tshul gyis ngom/ lag g.yas mdun nas bskor g.yon zur thur du brkyangs/ g.yon nam mkhar phyar/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la rkang g.yas btegs tsam ngos lus 'phar zhing de gar phab/ 'theng rkang gcig gi che ba la rkang g.yon btegs 'gro phyogs 'phyong zhing phab/ rkang g.yas btegs tsam byas nas de gar mnan/

rnga ma bskor nas dkrug cing 'bag gdong dpung g.yas steng phyogs la blta ba'i tshul gyis ngom/ lag g.yas phyir g.yugs te nam mkhar phyar/ g.yon pa thur la brkyang / 'theng rkang gi chung ba la rkang g.yon btegs tsam gyis 'phar nas de gar 'bebs pa sogs gong bzhin no/ /de lta bu'i rkyang 'gros kyis 'gro ba dang bstun/ rnga rdung ba rnams 'cham dpon dang bstun dal bus byon dbus su sleb nas 'cham dpon gyi sku rgyab tu gdan la gral rim bzhin langs nas sdod/ 'cham dpon gyis liṅga'i mtha' la skor ba gcig song nas rol mo bzhag ste sa la bsdad/ 'cham dpon bzhugs gdan steng du liṅga la zhal phyogs par rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ rol dpon nam skad bzang ba gcig gis sgrub thabs bzhin dgug gzhug lan gsum byings drangs dpon slob thams cad dmigs pa gsal zhing yi dam lha'i nga rgyal brtan pas mgrin gcig tu mdzad nas rdzogs mtshams rnams su rol mo chem rdung dang / 'cham pa rnams kyis ban gsig che zhing rnga ma mdun la dkrug liṅga phyogs la mkhas pa rnams kyis nyams gang dod kyis mchong rgyug lta bu cung zad ngos zil gang che bya/ de 'dra lan gsum gyi tha ma la/ pañca kan+dha/ dwe sogs lha dbye dang tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba'i dmigs pa rnams bzlog pa dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi zur 'debs bzhin ma chad cing gsal gang thebs byas rjes/ rol mo ba rnams 'theng rdung chung se ba dal bu ma chag pa'i ngang nas gdan khar bsdad/ 'cham dpon gyis rdor dril bzhag ral gri dang ban+dha thogs nas 'theng rkang ji ltar rigs pa'i bar 'cham pa rnams la phyogs kun tu blta zhing 'chams te/ de nas cung zad 'theng rkang che ba gsum la pad skor bya ba ni/ 'theng rkang dang po'i che ba la lag g.yas g.yon gyi gre mo'i 'og thad du g.yug cing / lus g.yon phyogs gcu/ lag g.yon snying ga'i thad tsam du bskor te kha phub ngos steng 'og tu yong ba bya/

rnga ma gsig cing 'bag gdong g.yon phyogs thur du blta/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la lus gsig pa dang sgyid ldem bya/ 'theng rkang gnyis pa'i che ba lag g.yas dpung g.yas steng gi nam mkhar phyar/ rnga ma rgyab la dkrug cing 'bag gdong ngom nas steng du blta/ lag g.yon pus g.yas 'khris su thur seg brkyang / 'theng rkang gi chung ba la gong bzhin lus nem gsig sgyid ldem 'dra/ 'theng rkang gsum pa la dang po bzhin la/ lag mgo gnyis mnyam pa ste yangs pad kyi tshul lo/ /pad skor dus g.yas kyi lag mgo gar 'gror 'bag gdong blta ba yin no/ /'og gi pad skor thams cad 'dis rigs 'gre de nas 'theng rkang lnga la dzam bya ste/ 'theng rkang dang po'i che ba la pad skor rdzogs pa'i lag mgo mnyam pa dang de las phral te g.yas zur du brkyang / de yang lag g.yas pus mo g.yas steng du kha phub dang / g.yon lag g.yas kyi gru mo'i nang tsam du kha phub ste sne bsnol lta bu bya zhing / 'bag gdong thur la blta/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la/ lus gsig cing dpung pa g.yon phyir gcu/ lag g.yon snying ga tsam du drud cing 'then/ rnga ma rgyab tu cung zad dkrugs shing 'bag gdong g.yon gyi dpung steng phyogs la blta zhing ngom/ 'theng rkang gnyis pa la g.yon zur/ gsum pa la g.yas/ bzhi pa la g.yon/ lnga pa la g.yas te re mos kyis byed pa dang / g.yas g.yon gyi khyad tsam ma gtogs 'cham tshul thams cad gong dang 'dra bas rigs 'gre shes par bya'o/ /lus g.yas gcu g.yon gcu'i dus rkang pa gnyis rting pa re mos kyis bskor/ de ltar dzam lnga rdzogs pa dang gong bzhin rkang 'gros ji ltar rigs pa byas rjes/ dngos gzhi seṅge'i brjid 'cham ni/ gong bzhin 'theng rkang gsum la pad skor gcig dang / dzam lnga song mtshams 'theng rkang gcig gi che ba la rkang g.yas btegs/ lag gnyis sa la mnan nas rnga ma rgyab la dkrug pa dang bstun 'bag ngom zhing lag gnyis rol pa ltar brgyangs te 'theng rkang gi chung ba la de ga'i ngang du 'gyings/

de nas 'theng rkang shin tu che ba lnga la g.yas skor bya ba ste/ dang po'i che ba la rkang g.yas mdun du phab/ de bzhin lag gnyis dang rnga ma yang mdun la phab/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la rkang g.yas btegs rnga ma rgyab la dkrug gsig che ba'i 'bag ngom/ lag gnyis rol pa ltar byed pa 'dra/ 'theng rkang gnyis pa la g.yas/ gsum pa la rgyab/ bzhi pa la g.yon te 'gro phyogs phab pa rnams gong bzhin che ba la phab/ chung ba la btegs/ 'on kyang bzhi pa'i chung ba la che ba brgyabs nas rkang g.yas btegs tsam byas ma thag 'phar nas phab/ rkang g.yon mdun du lnga pa'i che ba la 'phyong zhing phab/ chung ba la 'gying ste g.yas rgyab tu gcu ba dang shin tu ngam dal bar bya/ de nas pad skor dzam rkyang 'gros sogs gong bzhin byas la/ slar lan gnyis ldab nas byed pa'i 'gros nyis 'gros bya ste/ de la dzam rdzogs mtshams 'theng rkang gi che ba la rkang g.yas btegs nas 'gro phyogs 'phyong zhing phab/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la g.yas btegs/ yang 'theng rkang gcig gi che ba la 'gro phyogs sngar shul 'phyong ste phab/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la rkang g.yas btegs tsam ngos lus 'phar zhing gsig 'theng rkang gcig gi che ba gcig la rkang g.yon glo bur du btegs nas lus bskor zhing 'gro phyogs 'phyong nas phab/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la g.yon btegs/ yang 'theng rkang gcig gi che ba la 'gro phyogs sngar shul 'phyong te phab/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos lus 'phar zhing gsig rkang pa g.yas la 'theng rkang gnyis/ g.yon la gnyis te re mos su 'phyong / rkang pa 'bebs dus lag g.yas sa la 'bebs/ 'bag gdong g.yon la blta zhing rnga ma rgyab nas thur la bskor/ rkang pa 'degs dus lag g.yas dpung g.yas phyogs su phyar/ 'bag gdong g.yas steng bltas la rnga ma rgyab phyogs dkrug cing bskor nas gdong ngom/ lag g.yon 'bebs 'degs gnyis ka la thur du brkyang ngo / /'theng rkang bzhi rdzogs mtshams rnga skad ran pa gnyis la g.yas dang g.yon du 'phar nas cung zad 'phyong zhing lag gnyis g.yab pa'i tshul bya/

'theng rkang gcig la dbus su 'phar nas lag gnyis nam mkhar g.yab pa ni nyis 'gros g.yab mo dang bcas pa lags/ slar ldab nas byed na/ g.yab mo dbus kyi 'theng rkang gi chung ba yang cung che ba rgyag dus rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos de gar lus 'phar zhing phab nas/ yang 'theng rkang bzhi'i dang po'i che ba la rkang g.yas glo bur du btegs nas re mos 'phyong ba g.yab mo lan gsum sogs gong bzhin thengs gsum bzhi gang 'os byed pa ste seṅge'i brjid 'cham mo/ /'og tu nyis 'gros zhes pa'i dus 'di dran par bya'o/ /stag mo'i rngam 'cham ni/ pad skor dang dzam lnga gong bzhin byas nas/ rol mo drag myur bcu gcig gi thog ma'i gcig la rkang g.yas btegs tsam byas 'phral g.yon gyi rkang mgo'i 'khris su rtse mo btsugs nas phab/ lag gnyis mdun du g.yab cing skor nas nam mkhar brgyangs/ rnga ma dang lag mgo gnyis ban gsig ma chag pa mdun la dkrug la rkang mgo gnyis ma phral bar lus cung zad 'phar zhing g.yas skor byas te/ dgu bcu zhes pa'i dus lus 'phar ba shin tu che ba dang bstun/ rkang g.yas dgu la btegs nas myur du sa la rdeb pa bzhin 'phyong zhing phab/ bcu la rkang g.yon btegs glo bur du bskor lus 'phar te mdun du 'phyong la bgrad nas bcu gcig la phab ste lus g.yas rgyab phyogs la gcus/ rnga ma bskor rgyab la bsigs te 'bag gdong g.yas steng ngom/ lag gnyis brgyangs la sgyid ldem dang bcas 'gying zhing rol mo dal bar ngang bsrings nas sdod/ de nas pad skor dzam lnga/ 'gros g.yab mo gsum dang bcas pa gong bzhin bya/ de 'dra ba lan gsum byed pa ni stag mo'i rngam 'cham lags/ spyang mo'i 'dur 'cham la/ pad skor dbus su gcig de nas rkang g.yas rgyab la bskor rkang g.yon gyi rgyab tu spos/ rnga ma rgyab la bsigs shing pad skor gcig g.yas su byas la/ lag g.yon sked gzer dang / rnga ma bskor zhing lag g.yas g.yob tshul ngos rkang g.yas mdun phyogs 'theng rkang dal po bzhi'i bar la cung zad cung zad spos nas g.yas zur mdun du sleb mtshams rkang g.yas btegs tsam ngos bzhi rdung drag myur gnyis la mdun du sbad 'phyong lta bu rkang pa gnyis sa la drud lus 'phar chung gis 'gro ba ste/

de'ang bzhi rdung gi gsum zhes pa'i tshe rol mo che zhing mnan/ lus bsgyur rnga ma mdun gyi sa la ma reg tsam gsig bzhi la rkang g.yas btegs lag g.yas nam mkhar phyar/ rnga ma rgyab la bskyur 'bag gdong ngom/ bzhi rdung rjes ma'i bzhi la mi 'degs par mnan la 'theng rkang gcig la g.yon phyogs rgyab ngos 'phyong nas pad skor gcig byas la/ lag g.yas sked gzer byed pa sogs g.yas g.yon gyi khyad par tsam ma gtogs gong ji lta ba bzhin yin/ rjes kyi 'theng rkang gcig po mdun la kha bltas rkang gnyis bgrad/ lag gnyis brgyangs nas rgyab phyogs su phyir 'gros kyis 'phyong la/ pad skor/ dzam lnga/ nyis 'gros g.yab mo sogs gong bzhin byed pa ni spyang mo'i 'dur 'cham mo/ /de 'dra ba lan gsum bya ba'o/ /dred mo'i rgyug 'cham la/ dbus dang rgyab g.yas zur du pad skor byed pa gong bzhin byas rjes/ rkang g.yon rkang g.yas kyi rgyab tu spos la pad skor gcig yang gong bzhin rkang g.yas rgyab tu spos nas pad skor gcig ste bzhi la kha phyir blta nang blta sogs gzhi bca' song mtshams/ 'theng rkang chung ba bzhi'i gnyis la g.yon mdun dang / gnyis la g.yas zur rgyab tu dzam gyi rnam pa tsam gnyis re bya/ 'theng rkang bzhi pa'i chung ba la che ba brdeg cing lus nem la/ 'theng rkang che ba gnyis la g.yon mdun du 'phyong zhing ban gsig che ba dang bcas pa'i 'theng rkang dang po'i che ba la rkang g.yon btegs nas phab/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la btegs/ yang che ba la phab/ chung ba btegs 'phral phab pa'i dzam gnyis bya/ de bzhin rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas zur mdun la bstan nas 'phyong ba'i dzam drag po gnyis dang / yang rkang g.yos btegs gong bzhin mdun la 'theng rkang che ba gnyis la dzam drag po gnyis/ yang g.yon mdun la 'phyong zhing 'theng rkang che ba gnyis la dzam drag po gnyis gong bzhin byas rjes/ pad skor gcig byas/ de nas khyi nyal bya ba ni/ rkang g.yon btegs g.yas kyi rkang mgo'i 'khris su 'phred la bzhag

lag gnyis brgyangs te bzhi rdung gcig la rgod kyi gshog skor byed pa bzhin g.yas su bskor nas/ gsum zhes pa'i dus rol mo che zhing mnan/ lag gnyis pad skor ltar snying ga'i thad tsam du bskor/ lus sgur rnga ma sa la reg tsam bya/ bzhi la rkang g.yon btegs rnga ma rgyab la bskyur 'bag ngom/ lag gnyis brgyangs nas phyag mtshan rgyab phyogs dkrug de 'dra ba'i bzhi rdung gsum 'cham dang bcas pa song rjes/ pad skor gcig byas la/ lag g.yon sked gzer dang g.yas g.yob cing / rkang g.yas kyi rtse sa la reg tsam ngos cung zad re mdun phyogs su spos/ rol mo drag myur bcu gcig gi dgu la rol mo che ba mnan lus g.yas gcu zhing rnga ma mdun la phab/ lag g.yas sa la ma reg tsam byas nas gcu la rkang g.yas btegs lag g.yas pus mo'i 'og tsam mdun la bskor te dpung g.yas steng du sleb pa dang bcu gcig la phab/ rnga ma yang bskor zhing lag g.yas dang bstun mdun du gsig cing mnan/ len gyi rol mo chung ba la rkang g.yas btegs tsam byas 'phral phab pa ste don len the ba'i bcu gnyis su 'gro/ de nas bzhi rdung gnyis la mdun du spyang mo bzhin byas nas 'phyong rjes/ 'theng rkang gcig la g.yon phyogs rgyab ngos mchongs nas pad skor gcig byas la/ lag g.yas sked gzer byed pa lag g.yon g.yob pa sogs g.yas g.yon gyi khyad tsam ma gtogs/ bcu gnyis la bskor ba/ bzhi rdung gnyis la mchong ba rnams 'cham tshul gong bzhin ji lta ba bzhin rdzogs mtshams/ 'theng rkang gcig la rgyab tu mchong / 'theng rkang gcig la mdun du mchong / yang 'theng rkang gcig la/ mdun du kha bltas rkang gnyis bgrad/ lag gnyis brgyangs nas rgyab tu mchongs grub mtshams/ pad skor gcig dzam lnga nyis 'gros g.yab mo sogs gong bzhin no/ /'on kyang lan gsum byed pa'i rting ma la rkyang 'gros skor gcig bya ba ni dred mo'i rgyug 'cham mo/ /de nas liṅga gu gul gyis bdugs/

༈ 'cham dpon gyis rdor dril hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgyas bzung nas dgug gzhug lan gcig gong bzhin tshar ba dang rdor dril bzhag phyag mtshan thogs la lus sgur zhing rnga ma thur la phab/ rol mo dal bus cung zad sil le le ber blang ba dang bstun lus bsrangs shing rkang g.yas btegs/ lag gnyis brgyangs te rnga ma rgyab la gsig cing 'bag gdong ngom/ lus g.yas la gcus rol mo che ba gcig la rkang g.yas rgyab tu phab nas 'gyings/ de bzhin rol mo ber blang rkang g.yon btegs/ lus sgur nas bsrangs ba g.yon la gcus rol mo che ba gcig la rkang g.yon rgyab tu phab cing 'gying ba g.yas g.yon gyi khyad tsam ma gtogs 'cham tshul thams cad gong dang 'dra yang 'theng rkang gcig gi che ba la rkang g.yas bteg g.yas la gcu ba la sogs gong snga ma bzhin la 'gying ba yod tsam ngos/ 'theng rkang gi chung ba la rkang g.yas g.yas kyi mdun zur phab 'phral bzhi rdung gcig la/ rkang pa g.yas g.yon re mos kyis rol mo re dang bstun/ rkang pa btegs tsam rdog shud 'dra zhing lus re mos su gcu ba'i rol mo gcig la g.yas gcu dus/ lag pa g.yas sked pa tsam du brkyang / g.yon snying ga'i thad tsam du steng 'og yangs pad lta bu'i tshul gyi sne bsnol gyis bskor/ rol mo gnyis pa la/ g.yon gcu dus lag g.yon sked pa tsam brkyang / g.yas snying ga'i thad tsam du bskor ba sogs 'cham tshul gong dang 'dra/ gsum dang bzhi la yangs pad bya tshul/ g.yas g.yon du gcu ba sogs sngar ltar las/ bzhi pa rol mo che zhing rkang g.yon shed che ba'i sgo nas phab/ dpral ba'i thad tsam du g.yas kyi lag mgos g.yon la nang nas bskor zhing lag gnyis brgyangs te phyag mtshan g.yob pa/ rnga ma mdun la gsig g.yas skor du dgu rdung drag myur gyi bdun la rol mo lus rnga ma sogs g.yas su mnan zhing / lag gnyis g.yom bya/ brgyad la rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos de 'phral g.yon phyogs mchong zhing dgu la phab/

rkang g.yas sa la drud g.yon gyi 'khris su sleb pa dang / len gyi rol mo chung ba gcig ste bcu pa la/ lag gnyis lcags 'then bya/ 'theng rkang gcig la g.yas phyogs mchongs nas lcags 'then rdzogs mtshams/ bzhi rdung gi gcig dang bzhi la che ba/ gnyis dang gsum la chung ba ste rol mo'i rnam dbye shes dgos so/ /gong gi dgu rdungs/ bzhi 'gros sogs gdab kha dngos thams cad la 'cham tshul 'di bzhin yin pas 'gros la gri skor bya ba ste/ rol mo gcig gi dus rkang g.yas btegs g.yas 'gro phyogs mchongs shing / lag g.yas gri skor tshul gyis pus mo g.yas pa'i 'og nas bskor rkang g.yas phab/ gnyis pa la'ang g.yas btegs g.yon rgyab phyogs 'phar zhing mchong / g.yon lcags 'then bzhin 'drud/ gsum la mchongs shing g.yas phab/ bzhi la ban gsig che bas lus nem nas lag gnyis gri shub nas 'don tshul gyis lag g.yas dpral ba'i thad tsam la 'then/ g.yon thur bsegs brgyangs pa ste/ bzhi rdung gnyis la gri skor dang gri 'don gnyis yong ba bya/ bzhi rdung gnyis pa'i gcig la rkang g.yon btegs 'gro phyogs mchong zhing phab/ g.yas gong bzhin 'drud/ gnyis pa la g.yon btegs g.yas rgyab phyogs phyir 'gros su mchongs g.yas drud/ gsum pa dang bzhi pa la gong bzhin/ lag g.yon mchong thengs re la ban+dha 'gro phyogs g.yug g.yas thur bsegs brgyangs ba de 'dra gsum bzhi gang rigs bskyar nas bya ba ste 'gros/ de nas gdab ka dngos ni tshig dang bstun nas 'gros 'cham bzhin dal bus byed pa yin la/ de la rnga rdung ba rnams kyis skad gseng mthon pos 'then pa dang / dzaḥba'i ba'i zhes pa la 'cham dpon gyis g.yas zur du lag gnyis brkyangs nas 'cham zhing / ba ya'i dus lus nem gsig ngos rkang g.yas btegs la/ dam ma'i zhes la phab/ lag g.yas gong bzhin gri skor bya/ tshig gi dus rkang g.yas btegs sgyid ldem yod pa dang bcas/ chen na'i la 'gro phyogs lus nem che ba dang bcas phab/

po yis zer ba dang rkang g.yon btegs/ lag gnyis gri 'don tshul ngos gong bzhin brgyangs/ dus sa dang bstun 'gro phyogs phab/ la ba'i dus g.yon btegs/ bab zhes pa'i tshe phab/ ba'i ya'i zhes tshig sbrel mtshams la rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos lus nem dang bcas phab pa ste/ tshig re la gri skor gri 'don gong gi bzhi rdung gnyis dang 'dra ba'i gnyis rdzogs par bya/ don ban gsig dang / mchong tshul mi byed pa kha phyir blta nang blta tsam dal zhing don tshang ba bya dgos pas mi 'dra ba lta bu snang yang / zhi drag gi khyad tsam ma gtogs sa chog gi bka' bsgo ba/ bzhi 'gros gri skor ma rnams 'cham tshul 'dra ba yin no/ /de bzhin dbyangs tshig dang bstun la/ sprul pa chen po'i zhes pa nas/ bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la bab zhes pa dang rkang g.yon phab/ sbrel mtshams kyi tshigs lhod/ ba'i ya'i dus rkang g.yon btegs tsam ngos phab la rkang g.yas btegs/ g.yas phyogs su 'phar zhing mchongs nas bzhi rdung gi gcig la phab cing gnyis nas bzhi'i bar la pad skor byas nas g.yon sked gzer dang g.yas g.yob cing rnga ma gsig tsam ma chag pa mdun la bya/ rkang pa g.yas kyi rtse sa la reg tsam ngos cung zad re mdun phyogs su spos/ rol mo drag myur dgu'i bdun pa la rol mo che zhing lus mnan rnga ma mdun du dkrug rkang g.yas mnan/ lag g.yas sa la ma reg tsam byas nas/ brgyad la rkang g.yas btegs/ lag g.yas pus g.yas 'og tsam mdun la bskor te/ dpung g.yas steng du sleb pa dang / dgu la rkang g.yas phab/ rol mo che zhing dal ba'i sgo nas mnan/ lag g.yas gong bzhin bskor zhing sgyid ldem lhod skor ngang ring ba byas rjes len gyi rol mo chung ba gcig ste bcu pa la lus bsrangs nas/ lag g.yas bskor zhing rol mo gcig dang gnyis chung snyoms la lus cung zad gsig gsum shin tu che zhing mnan/ lus sgyid ldem sogs gong bzhin lag mgo sa la mnan/ bzhi la rkang pa ma btegs pa lus bsrang /

lag g.yas dpung steng sleb pa dang / 'bag rnga bskor te g.yas rgyab la bskyur 'bag ngom de 'dra ba bzhi rdung gnyis bskyar nas byas te lan gsum gyi rting ma'i bzhi la rnga ma rgyab la dkrug 'bag ngom zhing lus 'phar nas rgyab la mchong / lag gnyis brgyangs/ bzhi rdung gcig la pad skor 'theng rkang gsum la/ g.yas g.yon g.yas rnams su lcags 'then byas nas gong bzhin bzhi 'gros kyis gri skor ma ji ltar rigs par bya/ de ni gdab tshul lo/ /de nas byang chub mchog tu nas/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /zhes pa'i rjes la/ gdab tshul gong bzhin 'gros dang bcas pa bya/ yang khro bo chen po'i nas/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /zhes pa dang g.yas phyogs su 'phar zhing bzhi rdung gcig la pad skor byas nas 'theng rkang bzhi'i bar du/ g.yon zur mdun du bstan pa ngos su dzam lcags 'then bya/ de bzhin rgyab g.yas zur/ gong bzhin g.yon dang / g.yas zur du lcags 'then re ste bzhi song ba dang / chem rdung byed pa dang bstun 'cham dpon gyi liṅga bsgral phyir phyag mtshan bzhag mchod g.yog pas/ gong du bshams pa'i lcags phur phul zhing bzhes nas liṅga'i snying gar bsgril nas btab/ tshe lung khrus lung gi dmigs pa sogs bya zhing gnas spar/ phur shul thun gyis brabs la snying gar btsugs/ gzhan rnams kyis dgug gzhug bzhin ban gsig sogs gang spros 'jigs tshul ston/ de nas 'cham dpon gzhon pa yin na/ lcags phur khro bcu'i spyi phur thogs la/ gong bzhin g.yas g.yon du bskor ba sogs dgug gzhug rjes bzhin bzhi 'gros rnams bya/ gzhan gdab ka gnyis pa nas drug pa'i bar thams cad 'cham tshul gong bzhin dngos gzhi khyad par med/ 'on kyang bzhi pa ral gris gtub pa'i dus/ dzam nyug pa rnams mchong zhing lding zhing brgyugs nas 'cham dpon gyi 'khris su sleb pa dang / 'cham dpon dang mchod g.yog pas liṅga'i rgyu ma bton/

ma chad cing khrag ma 'thor bar rtog pa zhib len gyis rgyu ma'i rtse'i smyug ma rnams rim pa bzhin sprad/ dzam nyug pa rnams kyis kyang shed chung ba'i len lugs ngos rang gi khar bcug dbugs kyis bus nas brgyangs la rol mo dang bstun la dgu rdung gi dus phyi skor dang nang skor tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams dang 'dra ba byas na rgyu ma chad cing khrag phod ka la 'thor ba sogs skyon 'byung bas/ dgu rdung dang lcags 'then gyi dus mkhas nyams che la dod pa ban ling sogs lhu chags pa'i sgo nas byed pa gal che/ gdab ka drug pa'i dus chem rdung la gong bzhin ban ling che ngos rnga brdeg che ba gnyis dang 'theng rkang gcig la g.yas g.yon bskor zhing 'gying ba dang / 'theng rkang gi chung ba la rkang g.yon phab 'phral phyi nang gsang ba'i dbyangs byed pa dang bstun 'cham pa ni/ phyi ya'i zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yas g.yon gyi pus mo'i thad tsam g.yon phyogs su btegs/ lag gnyis thog mar g.yas zur du kha phub nas bskor de kha gyen bstan g.yas g.yon gyi dpung pa'i thad tsam du btegs te ling ro mchod pa'i tshul bya/ nang nga'i zhes brjod tshe rkang g.yas g.yas zur phab/ lag gnyis brkyangs g.yas su kha phub/ gsang nga'i dus gong bzhin lag gnyis kha gyen la bstan nas dpung g.yas steng tsam du mchod tshul rkang g.yon g.yas kyi pus mo'i thad tsam btegs/ ba'i ya'i dus su phyir 'gro phyogs g.yon zur du phab/ mchod do zer dus rkang g.yas btegs/ pa wa zhes pa dang 'gro phyogs phab/ /rgyam 'am zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs/ ma'i ma'i zhes pa'i dus g.yon 'gro phyogs phab/ mtsho bo zhes pa lag g.yas btegs/ ya'i ya'i dus rkang g.yas 'gro phyogs phab/ tshogs 'o 'o zhes pa'i dus rkang g.yon btegs/ wa zhes pa'i tshe rkang g.yon bskor zhing 'gro phyogs bgrad nas phab/ rkang g.yas rting pa btsugs/ 'a'i zhes pa dang g.yon du 'gying zhing / ya'i ya'i dus g.yas phyogs la nyis bstud du mchong zhing /

lag gnyis mchong phyogs rnga ma dang bcas dkrug de dang bstun rol mo chem rdung gnyis kyang bya/ tshig gnyis pa la rkang g.yon btegs rgyab g.yas kyi 'gro phyogs su phab/ rkang g.yas btegs 'gro phyogs su phab nas g.yas phyogs su 'gro zhing g.yon phyogs la mchong / gsum pa dang bzhi pa gong bzhin gyis re mos bya/ don rkang pa gang 'degs pa mi 'degs pa'i pus mo tsam du 'degs pa dang / rkang g.yas 'degs tshe lag gnyis g.yas zur kha phub ste dpung g.yon steng du gyen bstan gyi mchod tshul/ de bzhin rkang lag go bzlog g.yas g.yon gyi khyad tsam ma gtogs 'dra bas rnam dpyod kyis dpyod pa gal che/ tshig bzhi pa rdzogs mtshams mchong ba gnyis yod tsam ngos/ g.yas g.yon du ban gsig cung zad dang bcas pas rol mo bzhi rdung je myur je myur dang bstun/ ling ro mchod tshul byas/ mthar chem rdung dang liṅga'i dum bu rnams phyogs bcur gtor/ 'cham pa rnams phyogs gcig tu 'dus mtshams/ 'cham dpon gyis bzhi rdung chung ba gsum bzhi la 'chams nas/ bzhi rdung gong bzhin la lag g.yas gri kha 'byed pa bzhin gri shal ngos gri skor ma shor ba rang bya/ 'cham dpon gyis sna drangs te mchong che zhing 'grig pa kun gyi ngo mtshar du 'dzin pa'i rnam 'gyur mkhas shing las slar ma song ba rig pa bsgrims la 'cham khang du rim pas log 'gro ba ni nub tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa dgra bgegs brub kyi 'cham sngon 'gro cha lag dang bcas pa yongs su rdzogs pa bstan zin to/ /gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni 'cham chas rnams bzhag gral la 'khod de bskang gso bstod pa bsdus pa ltar so so'i phyag len bzhin dang rjes chog bkra shis kyi bar sgrub mchod dkyus ma bzhin mdzad pa'o/ /zhes pa rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub mchod rgyas pa'i phyag len phyag rgya'i gar 'cham dngos grub char 'bebs kyi 'cham dang / nub tha ma'i bsgral mchod dus dgos pa'i dgra bgegs brub kyi 'cham rtsa sogs ston pa 'cham dpe snang ba 'gyur thub zhes bya ba 'di ni rje btsun dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje dang mkhyen rab kyi mnga' bdag mahā paṇ+ḍi ta rig pa'i gnas lnga la thogs pa mi mnga' zhing /

rdo rje gzhon nu la sogs pa'i yi dam du mas rjes su bzung zhing zhal gzigs pa grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis rjes su bzung zhing bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas phyag len 'di rnams zhib tu gnang zhing nges par blo la zin pa'i lugs su byas nas/ rdo rje phur pa'i bstan pa la bsam zhing rigs kyi bu ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po dang / 'jam dbyangs bsod nams rgyal mtshan spun gyis bskul ba'i ngor rje btsun sa lo chen po de nyid kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa snyom las mkhan sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen gyis 'dzin byed ces pa me pho byi ba'i lo chu stod zla ba'i mkha' 'gro 'du zhing 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi dus chen khyad par can gyi nyin lha khang chen mo'i gtsug lag khang gi yang steng po ta la'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni ngag dbang dpal 'byor ro/ /'di la nyes pa'i tshogs mchis na bla ma dang chos srung dkar bdud phur srung sogs kyis bzod par mdzad nas/ rdo rje phur pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ kun rdzob spros pa'i gar 'cham rab 'bad pas/ /don dam spros bral myur du rab rtogs te/ /'jam dbyangs sa lo'i thugs dgongs rab rdzogs nas/ /lam 'dir zhugs nas dngos grub rab thob shog /rdo rje gzhon nu mchod pa'i cha lag gang / /rje btsun thugs rje can gyi phyag len bzhin/ /snyom las spangs te rtsol bas bsgrubs pa yis/ /dge des 'gro drug sangs rgyas myur thob shog/ //maṅga laṃ mastu sarba dza ga taṃ/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba la phan thogs par gyur cig/ // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 78 sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ rdo rje phur bu dngos grub char 'bebs kyi 'cham gyi brjed byang / PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 77
